jobs.title: Global Head of Climate Resilience 80-100%
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about helping customers become more resilient to climate risks and shaping Zurich’s global climate resilience agenda?

Zurich Resilience Solutions (ZRS) is Zurich’s dedicated commercial risk engineering and risk advisory business. We act as a trusted partner to underwriting teams, insurance customers and independent advisory clients. Our experts provide services and solutions that help customers understand, manage and reduce their risks – from core risk engineering lines such as Property, Casualty, Energy, Construction & Marine, through to climate and natural hazards, cyber, supply chain and other emerging risks.

As Global Head of Climate Resilience, you will own ZRS’s global climate resilience advisory proposition and thought leadership. Together with the country leaders, you will drive the development of climate-related risk solutions and business development across markets. In this role, you will ensure Zurich maintains a leading position in climate resilience, working closely with colleagues across Sustainability, Underwriting, Risk Engineering and our local business units.

What you will do

• Own ZRS’s global climate resilience advisory proposition, ensuring it is relevant, differentiated and aligned with Zurich’s sustainability ambitions and customer needs.

• Lead Zurich’s thought leadership agenda on climate resilience, including external publications, customer engagements, conference participation and industry partnerships.

• Lead a team of technical Climate Resilience professionals who drive the development and enhancement of climate-related risk solutions (e.g. analytics, advisory services, tools and methodologies) that help customers understand and manage physical and transition climate risks.

• Oversee the customer-facing advisory teams that work across many of our countries and regions.

• Alongside the country leaders, drive the business development activity across markets by working with local ZRS and

• Commercial teams to embed climate resilience solutions into propositions, customer conversations and go to market strategies.

• Monitor market trends, regulatory developments and stakeholder expectations related to climate resilience, and translate insights into actionable initiatives and solution enhancements.

• Work with ZRS leaders and SMEs to develop concrete risk mitigation strategies for our customers across geographies and industries, and to develop integrated propositions that bring the best of ZRS cross-line of business capabilities to our customers.

• Collaborate closely with Sustainability, Group Risk, Underwriting, and other key stakeholders to integrate climate resilience into Zurich’s broader sustainability strategy and commercial offering.

• Explore partnership opportunities to enhance the service offering to customers.

• Provide strategic guidance and coaching to regional and local teams on climate resilience topics to build capabilities and ensure consistent delivery of our advisory proposition.

What you bring

• Several years of experience in climate risk, sustainability, risk advisory, consulting or a related field, ideally with exposure to clients from many sectors.

• Strong expertise in climate-related risks (physical and/or transition) and their implications for businesses, infrastructure and communities.

• Expertise in risk engineering and underwriting.

• Proven track record in developing and/or delivering advisory propositions, solutions or services in a complex, international environment.

• Track record of commercial success in building/growing a business.

• Ability to translate technical climate and risk concepts into clear, actionable insights for senior stakeholders and customers.

• Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with experience working across functions and geographies.

• The ability to influence and lead in a global matrix structure.

• Strategic mindset combined with hands-on execution capability – comfortable moving from concept development to practical implementation.

• Excellent communication skills in English (spoken and written); additional languages are an advantage.

• A growth-oriented, proactive and resilient mindset, with a genuine passion for sustainability and helping customers build climate resilience.

- I team commerciali per incorporare soluzioni di resilienza climatica in proposizioni, conversazioni con i clienti e andare a strategie di mercato.

Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, Kunden zu helfen, widerstandsfähiger gegenüber Klimarisiken zu werden und die globale Klimaschutz-Agenda von Zurich zu gestalten?

Zurich Resilience Solutions (ZRS) ist das spezialisierte Business Risk Advisory von Zurich und arbeitet als Trusted Advisor für Underwriting, Versicherungskunden und unabhängige Beratungskunden. Wir bieten unseren Kunden Dienstleistungen und Lösungen, die ihnen helfen, ihre Risiken zu verstehen, zu managen und zu reduzieren – von Klima- und Naturgefahren bis hin zu Cyber-, Lieferketten- und anderen aufkommenden Risiken. Klimaresilienz ist eine Kernsäule unserer Nachhaltigkeitsstrategie und ein wesentliches Unterscheidungsmerkmal in unserem Kundenangebot.

Als Global Head of Climate Resilience werden Sie das globale Klimaresilienz-Beratungsangebot und die Vordenkerrolle von ZRS besitzen. Gemeinsam mit den Staats- und Regierungschefs werden Sie die Entwicklung klimabezogener Risikolösungen und die Geschäftsentwicklung in allen Märkten vorantreiben. In dieser Funktion stellen Sie sicher, dass Zurich eine führende Position im Bereich der Klimaresistenz einnimmt, indem Sie eng mit Kollegen aus den Bereichen Nachhaltigkeit, Underwriting, Risk Engineering und unseren lokalen Geschäftseinheiten zusammenarbeiten.

Was du tun wirst

- Eigenes globales Klimaresilienz-Beratungsangebot von ZRS, um sicherzustellen, dass es relevant, differenziert und auf die Nachhaltigkeitsambitionen und Kundenbedürfnisse von Zurich abgestimmt ist.

- Führen Sie die Vordenkeragenda von Zurich zu Klimaresilienz, einschließlich externer Publikationen, Kundenbindungen, Konferenzteilnahme und Branchenpartnerschaften.

- Führen Sie ein Team von Experten für Klimaresilienz, die die Entwicklung und Verbesserung klimabezogener Risikolösungen vorantreiben (z. B. Analysen, Beratungsdienste, Tools und Methoden), die Kunden dabei helfen, physische und Übergangs-Klimarisiken zu verstehen und zu managen.

- Beaufsichtigen Sie die kundenorientierten Beratungsteams, die in vielen unserer Länder und Regionen arbeiten.

- Führen Sie neben den Landesführern die Geschäftsentwicklung über Märkte hinweg durch die Zusammenarbeit mit lokalen ZRS und

- Kommerzielle Teams, um Lösungen zur Klimaresistenz in Vorschläge, Kundengespräche und Marktstrategien einzubetten.

- Überwachung von Markttrends, regulatorischen Entwicklungen und Erwartungen der Stakeholder in Bezug auf die Klimaresistenz und Umsetzung von Erkenntnissen in umsetzbare Initiativen und Lösungsverbesserungen.

- Arbeiten Sie mit ZRS-Führungskräften und KMU zusammen, um konkrete Risikominderungsstrategien für unsere Kunden in allen Regionen und Branchen zu entwickeln und integrierte Vorschläge zu entwickeln, die unseren Kunden das Beste aus den Geschäftsmöglichkeiten von ZRS bringen.

- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Nachhaltigkeit, Group Risk, Underwriting und anderen wichtigen Stakeholdern, um die Klimaresilienz in die breitere Nachhaltigkeitsstrategie und das kommerzielle Angebot von Zurich zu integrieren.

- Entdecken Sie Partnerschaftsmöglichkeiten, um das Serviceangebot für Kunden zu verbessern.

- Strategische Beratung und Coaching für regionale und lokale Teams zu Themen der Klimaresilienz, um Fähigkeiten aufzubauen und eine konsistente Umsetzung unseres Beratungsangebots sicherzustellen.

Was du mitbringst

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung in den Bereichen Klimarisiko, Nachhaltigkeit, Risikoberatung, Beratung oder einem verwandten Bereich, idealerweise mit Kunden aus vielen Branchen.

- Starke Expertise in klimabezogenen Risiken (physische und / oder Übergang) und deren Auswirkungen auf Unternehmen, Infrastruktur und Gemeinden.

- Expertise in Risk Engineering und Underwriting.

- Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Entwicklung und / oder Bereitstellung von Beratungsangeboten, Lösungen oder Dienstleistungen in einem komplexen, internationalen Umfeld.

- Track Record des kommerziellen Erfolgs beim Aufbau / Wachstum eines Unternehmens.

- Fähigkeit, technische Klima- und Risikokonzepte in klare, umsetzbare Erkenntnisse für Senior Stakeholder und Kunden zu übersetzen.

- Starke Fähigkeiten im Stakeholder-Management und in der Zusammenarbeit mit Erfahrung in allen Funktionen und Regionen.

- Die Fähigkeit, eine globale Matrixstruktur zu beeinflussen und zu führen.

- Strategisches Mindset kombiniert mit praktischer Ausführungsfähigkeit – bequemer Wechsel von der Konzeptentwicklung zur praktischen Umsetzung.

- Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch (gesprochen und geschrieben); zusätzliche Sprachen sind von Vorteil.

- Eine wachstumsorientierte, proaktive und widerstandsfähige Denkweise mit einer echten Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit und der Unterstützung der Kunden beim Aufbau einer Klimaresistenz.

Du gehörst hierher.

Stellen Sie sich vor, Sie arbeiten an einem der nachhaltigsten Arbeitsplätze der Welt. Auf dem Quai Zürich Campus genießen Sie eine Umgebung, die Ihnen helfen soll, zu gedeihen, mit Vorteilen, die Ihr Wohlbefinden und Ihre Wirkung unterstützen, und Möglichkeiten, Ihre besten Leistungen zu erbringen, umgeben von Top-Talenten und unterstützenden Kollegen.

Sie haben Zugang zu gesunden Nahrungsmitteln, Fitnesseinrichtungen und hellen, kollaborativen Räumen, die Kreativität auslösen. Im Herzen von Zürich am Ufer des Zürichsees gelegen, bietet der Campus eine hervorragende Anbindung an die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel, die Ihren Weg zur Arbeit vereinfachen.
Wachsen Sie mit uns durch den Zugang zu Lernressourcen, On-the-Job-Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Ermächtigung und Unterstützung. Seien Sie Teil eines Teams, das gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft schafft.

Über uns

Zurich ist ein führender Multiline-Versicherer, der über 82 Millionen Kunden in mehr als 200 Ländern und Regionen mit mehr als 65.000 Mitarbeitern betreut.
Seit über 150 Jahren verändert Zürich die Versicherung – und bietet nicht nur Schutz, sondern auch Präventionsleistungen, die Wohlbefinden und Klimaresistenz fördern.
Geleitet von unserem Ziel, gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft zu schaffen, wollen wir eines der verantwortungsvollsten und wirkungsvollsten Unternehmen der Welt sein.

Zurich Resilience Solutions (ZRS) est l'entreprise dédiée de conseil en risques commerciaux de Zurich, travaillant comme un conseiller de confiance pour la souscription, les clients d'assurance et les clients de conseil indépendants. Nous fournissons aux clients des services et des solutions qui les aident à comprendre, gérer et réduire leurs risques – des risques climatiques et naturels aux risques cybernétiques, à la chaîne d'approvisionnement et à d'autres risques émergents. En tant que Responsable Mondial de la Résilience Climatique, vous posséderez la proposition consultative de résilience climatique globale ZRS. Ce que vous ferez

- Sa propre proposition de conseil sur la résilience climatique mondiale ZRS, en s'assurant qu'elle est pertinente, différenciée et alignée sur les ambitions de développement durable de Zurich et les besoins des clients.

- Leader Zurich a pensé programme de leadership sur la résilience climatique, y compris des publications externes, des engagements des clients, la participation à des conférences et des partenariats industriels.

- Surveillez les équipes de conseil orientées vers les clients qui travaillent dans de nombreux pays et régions.

- Aux côtés des leaders du pays, pilotez l'activité de développement des entreprises sur les marchés en travaillant avec ZRS local et

- Des équipes commerciales pour intégrer des solutions de résilience climatique dans des propositions, des conversations avec les clients et des stratégies de marché.

- Surveiller les tendances du marché, l'évolution de la réglementation et les attentes des intervenants en matière de résilience au climat, et traduire les idées en initiatives concrètes et en améliorations des solutions.

- Collaborer avec les leaders et les PME de ZRS pour élaborer des stratégies concrètes d'atténuation des risques pour nos clients à travers les géographies et les industries, et développer des propositions intégrées qui apportent le meilleur de ZRS cross-line de capacités d'affaires à nos clients.

- Collaborer étroitement avec la durabilité, le risque collectif, la souscription et d'autres parties prenantes clés pour intégrer la résilience climatique dans la stratégie plus large de durabilité et l'offre commerciale de Zurich.

Ce que vous apportez

- Expertise en ingénierie des risques et en souscription.

- Expérience éprouvée dans l'élaboration et la prestation de propositions, de solutions ou de services consultatifs dans un environnement international complexe.

- Suivi du succès commercial dans la construction et la croissance d'une entreprise.

- Capacité de traduire les concepts de climat technique et de risque en idées claires et réalisables pour les principaux intervenants et les clients.

- Des compétences solides en gestion des intervenants et en collaboration, avec une expérience de travail dans les fonctions et les géographies.

- La capacité d'influencer et de diriger une structure matricielle globale.

- Un état d'esprit stratégique combiné avec une capacité d'exécution pratique – un passage confortable de l'élaboration du concept à la mise en œuvre pratique.

- Excellentes compétences en communication en anglais (parlé et écrit); langues supplémentaires sont un avantage.

- Un état d'esprit axé sur la croissance, proactif et résistant, avec une véritable passion pour la durabilité et aider les clients à renforcer la résilience climatique.

Du begleitest die Fälle von der ersten Abklärung bis zum Abschluss, beurteilst Deckung und Haftung und führst Verhandlungen mit allen beteiligten Parteien.

Dabei bist du regelmässig in der Region Zürich unterwegs, besichtigst Schadenorte und klärst Sachverhalte direkt vor Ort. Mit deinem sicheren Auftreten, deinem Verhandlungsgeschick und deinem Verständnis für die Situation der Betroffenen schaffst du Vertrauen – auch dann, wenn Interessen unterschiedlich sind. Gleichzeitig triffst du Entscheidungen eigenverantwortlich und stellst eine sorgfältige und effiziente Schadenbearbeitung sicher.

Wenn du eine vielseitige Aufgabe mit Gestaltungsspielraum suchst und Kundinnen und Kunden im Schadenfall kompetent unterstützen möchtest, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Sei affascinato dal legame tra vendite autonome, chiarimenti fondati e contatti con persone diverse? Volete utilizzare la vostra esperienza nell'assicurazione di proprietà e responsabilità per trovare soluzioni eque e sostenibili per i nostri clienti anche in situazioni difficili?

In questo ruolo, si tratta di casi complessi di reclami in responsabilità generale, come società e responsabilità privata, così come in vari tipi di assicurazione non vita. Are you fascinated by the connection between self-employed sales, well-founded clarifications and contact with different people? Would you like to use your experience in property and liability insurance to find fair and sustainable solutions for our customers even in demanding situations?

In this role, you will deal with complex claims cases in general liability – such as company and private liability – as well as in various types of non-life insurance. You accompany the cases from the first investigation to the conclusion, assess cover and liability and conduct negotiations with all parties involved.

You are regularly travelling in the Zurich region, visiting damage locations and clarifying matters directly on site. With your confident appearance, your negotiating skills and your understanding of the situation of those affected, you create trust – even if interests are different. At the same time, you take decisions on your own responsibility and ensure careful and efficient damage processing.

If you are looking for a versatile task with creative scope and would like to competently support customers in the event of damage, we look forward to your application.

Find out here why Zurich Switzerland is one of the "Top 3" employers in Switzerland. Become part of it and apply as a damage inspector.

What you do

- You handle complex claims in property and general liability insurance independently – from claim notification to conclusion.

- You clarify matters with insurance companies, injured parties, experts, lawyers and insurance companies and visit damage locations in the Zurich region.

- You assess insurance coverage, liability and scope of damage, document your clarifications and make decisions within your competences.

- You negotiate with all parties involved, coordinate the necessary measures and initiate damage payments.

- You examine opportunities for recourse, work with internal specialist offices and external partners and ensure clear, timely communication.

What you bring

- You have an education in insurance; a professional card insurance or a degree from a high school insurance is an advantage.

- You have at least five years of professional experience in handling claims, ideally in property and/or general liability insurance.

- You will bring in-depth knowledge in the coverage and liability assessment as well as experience in dealing with complex claims cases.

- You negotiate safely, perform convincingly even in demanding situations and find pragmatic and customer-oriented solutions.

- You work independently, structured and reliable, communicate very well in German and have good MS-Office skills; Other language skills are an advantage.

Your contact

jobs.description:
Du baust gerne Modelle, die aus Finanzdaten belastbare Entscheidungsgrundlagen machen?
Du willst Planung und Forecasting bei Zurich Schweiz auf das nächste Level bringen und aktiv mitgestalten?

Wir sind das Team, das die Transformation im Controlling der Zurich Schweiz vorantreibt – als Teil der weltweiten Finance Transformation der Zurich Gruppe. Wir stellen Ist-, Forecast- und Plandaten für P&C, Life und Expenses bereit und sorgen mit unserem semantischen Datenmodell für eine effiziente Datenbasis und korrekte Kennzahlen.

Mit Anaplan gestalten wir unsere Planungs- und Forecastprozesse neu. Als Senior Anaplan Model Builder übernimmst du dabei eine Schlüsselrolle: Du baust die Modelle für Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), verbindest sie mit unserer Reportingwelt rund um Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, SQL und Databricks – und gibst dein Anaplanwissen an weniger erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen weiter.

Erfahre hier , weshalb Zurich Schweiz zu den «Top 3» Arbeitgebern der Schweiz zählt. Werde auch du Teil davon und bewirb dich als Senior Anaplan Model Builder FP&A.

Was du tust

• Du konzipierst und baust Planungs-, Forecast- und Simulationsmodelle in Anaplan – von der Modellarchitektur über die Berechnungslogik bis zu verständlichen Views und Dashboards.

• Du nimmst Anforderungen unserer Controlling-Kolleginnen und -Kollegen auf, strukturierst sie und übersetzt sie in fachliche Konzepte, User Stories und skalierbare Modelllösungen.

• Du integrierst und automatisierst die Anaplan-Lösung in unsere Reportinginfrastruktur rund um Power BI, Microsoft Azure/Fabric, SQL und Databricks – für zuverlässige und nachvollziehbare Datenflüsse.

• Du bildest Junior und weniger erfahrene Model Builder aus und agierst als Sparringpartner für unsere internen Kundinnen und Kunden.

• Du arbeitest eng mit Finance, IT, Data Engineers und BI Specialists sowie mit dem globalen Anaplan-Team zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Business Unit Anforderungen und Group-Standards zusammenpassen.

Was du mitbringst

jobs.description:
In this role as Head of Legal IT and Operations within the Group Legal Department of Zurich you will lead the Legal Team that supports internal stakeholders of Zurich on all issues related to strategic sourcing and Information Technology (IT). You will lead the team that provides legal advice in connection with outsourcing and procurement contracts, with the deployment of new technologies and digitalization and potentially a variety of other topics. You are responsible for the provision of legal advice and guidance to the business related to sourcing and procurement process, contract drafting and negotiations.

What you will do

• General legal advice in the area of strategic sourcing and IT procurement including e-commerce and digitalization, e.g. online contract formation, distribution of digital customer offerings, incl. Apps etc.

• Legal advice on contracting in particular, especially by way of drafting and negotiating various sourcing contracts and in particular large international outsourcing contracts.

• Tailoring of the advice per the above within the context and confines of the various insurance business activities of Zurich.

• Maintaining the terms and conditions for intra-group agreements and reviewing intra-group agreements from a Group perspective.

• Provide support to Zurich Capability Centers around the globe.

• Provide Board Secretariat support to certain Group entities.

• Lead and develop a team of two specialized lawyers.

What you bring

• Law degree and Bar exam, preferably from Switzerland

• Post graduate degree in foreign jurisdiction and/or foreign working experience is an advantage

• At least ten years of relevant experience in the areas of contract drafting and negotiations, preferably in the area of IT/new technologies and the (digital) distribution of offerings/services incl. the associated legal topics (agency law, unfair competition etc.), especially in the context of insurance/financial services

• Good knowledge of the captive reinsurance business and experience in drafting, reviewing and negotiating captive reinsurance contracts.

• Interest in (new) technology and related legal environment and eagerness to deepen specialist know-how in mentioned areas

• Experience in working on global or regional projects and in coordinating lawyers in other jurisdictions

• Sound negotiating skills as well as strong communication skills

• Fluent written and spoken English and German skills, any other language is a plus

You belong here.

Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus , you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.

You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple.

Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together.

About Us

Zurich is a leading multi-line insurer, serving over 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories with more than 65,000 employees.
For over 150 years, Zurich has been transforming insurance – offering not just protection, but also prevention services that promote well-being and climate resilience.
Guided by our purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ we aim to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world.

We look forward to receiving your online application today!

Zurich does not accept any applications from recruitment agencies for this position. We refuse any responsibility for unsolicited applications, as well as any associated fees.

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We are an equal opportunity employer who knows that each employee is unique - that’s what makes our team so great!
Join us as we constantly explore new ways to protect our customers and the planet .

- Laurea post-laurea in giurisdizione straniera e/o esperienza lavorativa straniera è un vantaggio

- Almeno dieci anni di esperienza rilevante nei settori della redazione e dei negoziati dei contratti, preferibilmente nel settore delle tecnologie IT/nuove e della distribuzione (digitale) di offerte/servizi incl. gli argomenti legali associati (diritto dell'agenzia, concorrenza sleale ecc.), soprattutto nel contesto dei servizi assicurativi/finanziari

- Buona conoscenza del business e dell'esperienza di riassicurazione in cattività nella redazione, revisione e negoziazione di contratti di riassicurazione prigionieri.

- Interessi in (nuovi) tecnologia e relativi ambienti giuridici e desiderio di approfondire il know-how specialistico nelle aree menzionate

- Esperienza nel lavoro su progetti globali o regionali e nel coordinamento degli avvocati in altre giurisdizioni

- Capacità di negoziazione sonore e forti capacità di comunicazione

- Fluente scritto e parlato inglese e tedesco competenze, qualsiasi altra lingua è un plus

Tu appartieni qui.

Immaginate di lavorare in uno dei luoghi di lavoro più sostenibili del mondo. Presso il Quai Zurich Campus, ti godrai di un ambiente progettato per aiutarti a prosperare, con benefici che supportano il tuo benessere e l'impatto, e opportunità di esibirti al meglio, circondati da grandi talenti e colleghi di supporto.

Avrete accesso a opzioni di cibo sano, strutture fitness, e spazi luminosi e collaborativi che scintillano la creatività. Situato nel cuore di Zurigo, sulle rive del Lago di Zurigo, il campus offre ottimi collegamenti con i mezzi pubblici, rendendo il vostro viaggio semplice.

Crescere con noi attraverso l'accesso alle risorse di apprendimento, lo sviluppo on-the-job, e l'empowerment continuo e il supporto. Fai parte di una squadra che sta creando un futuro più luminoso insieme.

Informazioni su di noi

Zurigo è un'azienda multi-linea leader, con oltre 82 milioni di clienti in oltre 200 paesi e territori con oltre 65.000 dipendenti.
Da oltre 150 anni, Zurigo sta trasformando l'assicurazione – offrendo non solo protezione, ma anche servizi di prevenzione che promuovono il benessere e la resilienza climatica.
Guidato dal nostro scopo di “creare un futuro più luminoso insieme”, ci proponiamo di essere una delle aziende più responsabili e d’impatto al mondo.

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione online oggi!
descriptionByLocale.en:
In this role as Head of Legal IT and Operations within the Group Legal Department of Zurich you will lead the Legal Team that supports internal stakeholders of Zurich on all issues related to strategic sourcing and Information Technology (IT). You will lead the team that provides legal advice in connection with outsourcing and procurement contracts, with the deployment of new technologies and digitalization and potentially a variety of other topics. You are responsible for the provision of legal advice and guidance to the business related to sourcing and procurement process, contract drafting and negotiations.

What you will do

• General legal advice in the area of strategic sourcing and IT procurement including e-commerce and digitalization, e.g. online contract formation, distribution of digital customer offerings, incl. Apps etc.

• Legal advice on contracting in particular, especially by way of drafting and negotiating various sourcing contracts and in particular large international outsourcing contracts.

• Tailoring of the advice per the above within the context and confines of the various insurance business activities of Zurich.

• Maintaining the terms and conditions for intra-group agreements and reviewing intra-group agreements from a Group perspective.

• Provide support to Zurich Capability Centers around the globe.

• Provide Board Secretariat support to certain Group entities.

• Lead and develop a team of two specialized lawyers.

What you bring

• Law degree and Bar exam, preferably from Switzerland

• Post graduate degree in foreign jurisdiction and/or foreign working experience is an advantage

• At least ten years of relevant experience in the areas of contract drafting and negotiations, preferably in the area of IT/new technologies and the (digital) distribution of offerings/services incl. the associated legal topics (agency law, unfair competition etc.), especially in the context of insurance/financial services

• Good knowledge of the captive reinsurance business and experience in drafting, reviewing and negotiating captive reinsurance contracts.

• Interest in (new) technology and related legal environment and eagerness to deepen specialist know-how in mentioned areas

• Experience in working on global or regional projects and in coordinating lawyers in other jurisdictions

• Sound negotiating skills as well as strong communication skills

• Fluent written and spoken English and German skills, any other language is a plus

You belong here.

Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus , you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.

You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple.

Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together.

About Us

Zurich is a leading multi-line insurer, serving over 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories with more than 65,000 employees.
For over 150 years, Zurich has been transforming insurance – offering not just protection, but also prevention services that promote well-being and climate resilience.
Guided by our purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ we aim to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world.

We look forward to receiving your online application today!

Information for recruitment agencies

Zurich does not accept any applications from recruitment agencies for this position. We refuse any responsibility for unsolicited applications, as well as any associated fees.

Why Zurich

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We are an equal opportunity employer who knows that each employee is unique - that’s what makes our team so great!
Join us as we constantly explore new ways to protect our customers and the planet .

• Location(s): CH - Zürich

• Remote working: Hybrid

• Schedule: Full Time

• Recruiter name: Grace Cunningham
descriptionByLocale.de:
In dieser Funktion als Head of Legal IT and Operations in der Group Legal Abteilung Zürich leiten Sie das Legal Team, das die internen Stakeholder von Zürich in allen Fragen rund um strategische Beschaffung und Informationstechnologie (IT) unterstützt. Du leitest das Team, das dich bei Outsourcing- und Beschaffungsverträgen, beim Einsatz neuer Technologien und der Digitalisierung und möglicherweise bei einer Vielzahl weiterer Themen rechtlich berät. Sie sind für die Bereitstellung von Rechtsberatung und Beratung für das Geschäft im Zusammenhang mit Beschaffungs- und Beschaffungsprozess, Vertragsgestaltung und Verhandlungen verantwortlich.

Was du tun wirst

- Allgemeine Rechtsberatung im Bereich strategische Beschaffung und IT-Beschaffung einschließlich E-Commerce und Digitalisierung, z.B. Online-Vertragsbildung, Vertrieb von digitalen Kundenangeboten, inkl. Apps etc.

- Rechtsberatung insbesondere bei der Auftragsvergabe, insbesondere bei der Erstellung und Verhandlung verschiedener Beschaffungsverträge und insbesondere großer internationaler Outsourcing-Verträge.

- Maßgeschneiderte Beratung im Rahmen der verschiedenen Versicherungsgeschäftsaktivitäten von Zürich.

- Beibehaltung der Bedingungen für gruppeninterne Vereinbarungen und Überprüfung gruppeninterner Vereinbarungen aus der Perspektive der Gruppe.

- Unterstützen Sie Zurich Capability Center weltweit.

- Unterstützung des Vorstandssekretariats für bestimmte Unternehmen der Gruppe.

- Führen und entwickeln Sie ein Team von zwei spezialisierten Anwälten.

Was du mitbringst

- Jurastudium und Rechtsanwaltsprüfung, vorzugsweise aus der Schweiz

- Postgraduiertenabschluss in ausländischer Gerichtsbarkeit und / oder ausländische Berufserfahrung ist von Vorteil

- Mindestens zehn Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung in den Bereichen Vertragsgestaltung und Verhandlungen, vorzugsweise im Bereich IT/Neue Technologien und (digitaler) Vertrieb von Angeboten/Dienstleistungen inkl. die damit verbundenen Rechtsthemen (Agenturrecht, unlauterer Wettbewerb etc.), insbesondere im Rahmen von Versicherungen/Finanzdienstleistungen

- Gute Kenntnisse des firmeneigenen Rückversicherungsgeschäfts und Erfahrung in der Erstellung, Überprüfung und Verhandlung von firmeneigenen Rückversicherungsverträgen.

- Interesse an (neuen) Technologien und dem damit verbundenen rechtlichen Umfeld und Eifer zur Vertiefung des Fachwissens in den genannten Bereichen

- Erfahrung in der Arbeit an globalen oder regionalen Projekten und in der Koordination von Anwälten in anderen Jurisdiktionen

- Solides Verhandlungsgeschick sowie starke Kommunikationsfähigkeit

- fließend geschriebenes und gesprochenes Englisch und Deutsch, jede andere Sprache ist ein Plus

Du gehörst hierher.

Stellen Sie sich vor, Sie arbeiten an einem der nachhaltigsten Arbeitsplätze der Welt. Auf dem Quai Zürich Campus genießen Sie eine Umgebung, die Ihnen helfen soll, zu gedeihen, mit Vorteilen, die Ihr Wohlbefinden und Ihre Wirkung unterstützen, und Möglichkeiten, Ihre besten Leistungen zu erbringen, umgeben von Top-Talenten und unterstützenden Kollegen.

Sie haben Zugang zu gesunden Nahrungsmitteln, Fitnesseinrichtungen und hellen, kollaborativen Räumen, die Kreativität auslösen. Im Herzen von Zürich am Ufer des Zürichsees gelegen, bietet der Campus eine hervorragende Anbindung an die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel, die Ihren Weg zur Arbeit vereinfachen.

Wachsen Sie mit uns durch den Zugang zu Lernressourcen, On-the-Job-Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Ermächtigung und Unterstützung. Seien Sie Teil eines Teams, das gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft schafft.

Über uns

Zurich ist ein führender Multiline-Versicherer, der über 82 Millionen Kunden in mehr als 200 Ländern und Regionen mit mehr als 65.000 Mitarbeitern betreut.
Seit über 150 Jahren verändert Zürich die Versicherung – und bietet nicht nur Schutz, sondern auch Präventionsleistungen, die Wohlbefinden und Klimaresistenz fördern.
Geleitet von unserem Ziel, gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft zu schaffen, wollen wir eines der verantwortungsvollsten und wirkungsvollsten Unternehmen der Welt sein.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Online-Bewerbung noch heute!
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Dans ce rôle en tant que chef de l'informatique juridique et des opérations au sein du département juridique du groupe de Zurich, vous dirigerez l'équipe juridique qui soutient les acteurs internes de Zurich sur toutes les questions liées à l'approvisionnement stratégique et aux technologies de l'information (TI). Vous dirigerez l'équipe qui fournit des conseils juridiques dans le cadre des contrats d'externalisation et d'approvisionnement, avec le déploiement de nouvelles technologies et la numérisation et éventuellement une variété d'autres sujets. Vous êtes responsable de la fourniture de conseils et d'orientations juridiques à l'entreprise en ce qui concerne le processus d'approvisionnement et d'approvisionnement, la rédaction des contrats et les négociations.

Ce que vous ferez

- Conseils juridiques généraux dans le domaine de l'approvisionnement stratégique et de l'approvisionnement en TI, y compris le commerce électronique et la numérisation, p. ex. formation de contrats en ligne, distribution d'offres de clients numériques, y compris Applications, etc.

- Conseils juridiques sur la passation de marchés en particulier, en particulier dans le cadre de la rédaction et de la négociation de divers contrats d'approvisionnement et en particulier de grands contrats internationaux d'externalisation.

- Adapter les conseils en fonction de ce qui précède dans le contexte et les limites des différentes activités d'assurance de Zurich.

- Maintenir les modalités des accords intragroupe et examiner les accords intragroupe du point de vue du Groupe.

- Fournir un soutien aux centres de capacités de Zurich dans le monde entier.

- Fournir un appui du Secrétariat du Conseil à certaines entités du Groupe.

- Diriger et développer une équipe de deux avocats spécialisés.

Ce que vous apportez

- Diplôme de droit et examen du barreau, de préférence de Suisse

- Un diplôme d'études supérieures en juridiction étrangère et/ou expérience de travail étrangère est un avantage

- Au moins dix ans d'expérience pertinente dans les domaines de la rédaction et des négociations des contrats, de préférence dans le domaine des technologies de l'information et des nouvelles technologies et de la distribution (numérique) des offres/services, y compris les questions juridiques connexes (droit des organismes, concurrence déloyale, etc.), en particulier dans le contexte des services d'assurance et des services financiers

- Bonne connaissance de l'activité de réassurance captive et de l'expérience acquise dans la rédaction, l'examen et la négociation de contrats de réassurance captive.

- Intérêt pour les (nouvelles) technologies et environnement juridique connexe et empressement à approfondir le savoir-faire spécialisé dans les domaines mentionnés

- Expérience dans le travail sur des projets mondiaux ou régionaux et dans la coordination des avocats dans d'autres juridictions

- Bonnes compétences en matière de négociation et de communication

- Compétences écrites et parlées en anglais et en allemand, toute autre langue est un plus

Tu es ici.

Imaginez travailler dans l'un des lieux de travail les plus durables du monde. Au campus Quai Zurich , vous profiterez d'un environnement conçu pour vous aider à prospérer, avec des avantages qui soutiennent votre bien-être et votre impact, et des occasions de se produire à votre meilleur, entouré de talents et de collègues de soutien.

Vous aurez accès à des options alimentaires saines, des installations de remise en forme et des espaces de collaboration lumineux qui stimulent la créativité. Situé au cœur de Zurich sur les rives du lac de Zurich, le campus offre d'excellentes liaisons de transport en commun, ce qui facilite votre trajet.

Développez avec nous grâce à l'accès aux ressources d'apprentissage, au développement en cours d'emploi et à l'autonomisation et au soutien continus. Faites partie d'une équipe qui crée ensemble un avenir meilleur.

À propos de nous

Zurich est un assureur multiligne leader, desservant plus de 82 millions de clients dans plus de 200 pays et territoires avec plus de 65 000 employés.
Depuis plus de 150 ans, Zurich transforme l'assurance en offrant non seulement une protection, mais aussi des services de prévention qui favorisent le bien-être et la résilience climatique.
Guidée par notre objectif de « créer ensemble un avenir meilleur », nous visons à être l'une des entreprises les plus responsables et les plus influentes du monde.

Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature en ligne aujourd'hui!

jobs.description:
At Zurich, our ambition is to put customers at the heart of everything we do and become the insurer of choice by building meaningful relationships that earn customer loyalty over time.

Over the past several years, we have made significant progress in building customer thinking into our strategy, products, services and ways of working. However, there is still more to do to ensure customer perspectives consistently shape decisions across the organisation and become embedded in our everyday mindset and culture. We believe better customer understanding leads to better business decisions.

The Group Customer Office plays a central role in this transformation, partnering with markets and functions around the world to ensure the voice of the customer is heard, understood and acted upon. Through customer, market and brand insights, we help the business better understand changing customer needs, identify opportunities for improvement and make decisions that strengthen customer loyalty, drive growth and create long-term value.

To support this effort, we are looking for a passionate, curious and commercially minded insights professional to join our Customer, Market & Brand Insights team. This role is paramount in translating our data and research into actionable insights that influence business decisions and drive meaningful change.

Working closely with markets, regional stakeholders and senior leaders, you will help evolve and deliver our global brand and experience insights tracking tools to deliver value to the business, ensuring customer understanding influences business decisions and actions.

As we continue to embrace AI and new analytical capabilities, we are also transforming how insight is generated and activated, allowing us to spend less time producing reports and more time influencing decisions and delivering impact.

Reporting to the Head of Global Brand Tracking & NPS, this role will focus on understanding how our brand health created through our products, services and experiences shapes customer perceptions and behaviours, and ensuring those insights are translated into actions that improve customer outcomes and business performance.

What you will do

As Senior Insight Manager you will:

• Champion the voice of the customer, helping embed customer thinking into decision-making across Zurich.

• Generate compelling customer and brand insights that influence to drive business impact

• Oversee Zurich's global retail Brand and Relationship NPS programmes and lead our Commercial Broker study, ensuring high-quality delivery, governance and business value.

• Evolve our insight programmes and measurement approaches to ensure they remain relevant to changing customer and business needs.

• Transform complex data into clear, actionable recommendations and executive-level narratives that drive action.

• Partner with the insights team, markets, agencies and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, solve business challenges and accelerate customer-centred change.

• Connect customer, brand and business data to strengthen understanding of performance drivers and commercial impact.

• Facilitate discussions and workshops that turn insight into tangible business outcomes.

• Work closely with the Tracking Insight Manager and TNPS Expert to maximise the impact, adoption and activation of insights across the organisation.

• Bring external best practice, innovation and emerging AI capabilities into Zurich's insight ecosystem to continuously enhance how we generate and apply insight.

Work location is Zurich with travel potentially required up to 10%

What you bring

As Senior Insight Manager, you will bring:

• A passion for understanding customers and translating customer, market and brand data into meaningful business opportunities and actions.

• Strong storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to distil complex information into clear, compelling narratives that influence decision-making.

• Proven experience activating insights within organisations, driving awareness, engagement and action across diverse stakeholder groups.

• Expertise in leading continuous and ad hoc qualitative and quantitative research programmes, either within an in-house insights function or consultancy environment.

• Strong commercial acumen and the ability to connect customer insights with business performance, growth and loyalty outcomes.

• Experience managing complex global programmes and building effective relationships across markets, functions and cultures.

• Demonstrated ability to influence and engage senior stakeholders, facilitating discussions and workshops that drive alignment and action.

• Curiosity and practical experience applying AI and emerging technologies to enhance insight generation, synthesis and activation.

• Strong analytical skills with experience working with large datasets and statistical tools (e.g. Excel, SPSS), turning data into actionable recommendations.

• Experience bringing together multiple data sources to identify performance drivers and generate deeper business understanding.

• A degree (e.g. in business studies, marketing, research, psychology, behavioural science, customer or change management or a related field), alongside significant experience in customer, market or brand insights.

• Knowledge of the insurance sector is beneficial but not essential; curiosity, commercial thinking and a customer-first mindset are critical.

• Fluent English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

You belong here.

Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus, you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.

You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities

The Group Customer Office plays a central role in this transformation, partnering with markets and functions around the world to ensure the voice of the customer is heard, understood and acted upon. Through customer, market and brand insights, we help the business better understand changing customer needs, identify opportunities for improvement and make decisions that strengthen customer loyalty, drive growth and create long-term value.

To support this effort, we are looking for a passionate, curious and commercially minded insights professional to join our Customer, Market & Brand Insights team. This role is paramount in translating our data and research into actionable insights that influence business decisions and drive meaningful change.

Working closely with markets, regional stakeholders and senior leaders, you will help evolve and deliver our global brand and experience insights tracking tools to deliver value to the business, ensuring customer understanding influences business decisions and actions.

As we continue to embrace AI and new analytical capabilities, we are also transforming how insight is generated and activated, allowing us to spend less time producing reports and more time influencing decisions and delivering impact.

Reporting to the Head of Global Brand Tracking & NPS, this role will focus on understanding how our brand health created through our products, services and experiences shapes customer perceptions and behaviours, and ensuring those insights are translated into actions that improve customer outcomes and business performance.

What you will do

As Senior Insight Manager you will:

- Champion the voice of the customer, helping embed customer thinking into decision-making across Zurich.

- Generate compelling customer and brand insights that influence to drive business impact

- Oversee Zurich's global retail Brand and Relationship NPS programmes and lead our Commercial Broker study, ensuring high-quality delivery, governance and business value.

- Evolve our insight programmes and measurement approaches to ensure they remain relevant to changing customer and business needs.

- Transform complex data into clear, actionable recommendations and executive-level narratives that drive action.

- Partner with the insights team, markets, agencies and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, solve business challenges and accelerate customer-centred change.

- Connect customer, brand and business data to strengthen understanding of performance drivers and commercial impact.

- Facilitate discussions and workshops that turn insight into tangible business outcomes.

- Work closely with the Tracking Insight Manager and TNPS Expert to maximise the impact, adoption and activation of insights across the organisation.

- Bring external best practice, innovation and emerging AI capabilities into Zurich's insight ecosystem to continuously enhance how we generate and apply insight.

Work location is Zurich with travel potentially required up to 10%

What you bring

As Senior Insight Manager, you will bring:

- A passion for understanding customers and translating customer, market and brand data into meaningful business opportunities and actions.

- Strong storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to distil complex information into clear, compelling narratives that influence decision-making.

- Proven experience activating insights within organisations, driving awareness, engagement and action across diverse stakeholder groups.

- Expertise in leading continuous and ad hoc qualitative and quantitative research programmes, either within an in-house insights function or consultancy environment.

- Strong commercial acumen and the ability to connect customer insights with business performance, growth and loyalty outcomes.

- Experience managing complex global programmes and building effective relationships across markets, functions and cultures.

- Demonstrated ability to influence and engage senior stakeholders, facilitating discussions and workshops that drive alignment and action.

- Curiosity and practical experience applying AI and emerging technologies to enhance insight generation, synthesis and activation.

- Strong analytical skills with experience working with large datasets and statistical tools (e.g. Excel, SPSS), turning data into actionable recommendations.

- Experience bringing together multiple data sources to identify performance drivers and generate deeper business understanding.

- A degree (e.g. in business studies, marketing, research, psychology, behavioural science, customer or change management or a related field), alongside significant experience in customer, market or brand insights.

- Knowledge of the insurance sector is beneficial but not essential; curiosity, commercial thinking and a customer-first mindset are critical.

- Fluent English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

You belong here.

Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus, you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.

You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple.

Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together.

About Us

Zurich is a leading multi-line insurer, serving over 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories with more than 65,000 employees.
For over 150 years, Zurich has been transforming insurance – offering not just protection, but also prevention services that promote well-being and climate resilience.
Guided by our purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ we aim to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world.

We look forward to receiving your online application today!

jobs.description:
Bist du begeistert von der Schadenbearbeitung und möchtest eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Abwicklung von Leistungen für die Mitarbeitenden unserer Kunden übernehmen? Hast du ein Talent dafür, mehrere Schadenprozesse in einem dynamischen Umfeld zu steuern und dabei die Erfahrung unserer Versicherten kontinuierlich zu verbessern?

In unserem vielfältigen und mehrsprachigen Kundenteam KTG arbeitest du eng mit internen und externen Partnern zusammen und trägst dazu bei, dass unsere Kundinnen und Kunden im Leistungsfall schnell und kompetent unterstützt werden. Dich erwartet eine flexible Arbeitsumgebung, in der du Verantwortung übernehmen, deine Fachkompetenz vertiefen und dich persönlich wie beruflich weiterentwickeln kannst.

Ein hervorragender Service ist nur so gut wie das Team dahinter: Wir suchen engagierte Fachspezialistinnen und Fachspezialisten, die mit Leidenschaft für Kundenthemen brennen, gerne im Team arbeiten und ihre Karriere bei Zurich Schweiz gezielt vorantreiben möchten.

Erfahre hier , weshalb Zurich Schweiz zu den «Top 3» Arbeitgebern der Schweiz zählt. Werde auch du Teil davon und bewirb dich als Spzialist Kundenteam KTG.

Was du tust

• Du regelst die Leistungen bei Krankheiten der Mitarbeiter unserer Kunden gemäss den gesetzlichen und vertraglichen Bestimmungen

• Du korrespondierst und führst Gespräche mit den verschiedenen Parteien, die an der Schadenregulierung beteiligt sind (Versicherte, Arbeitgeber, medizinischer Dienst, andere Versicherer, Anwälte)

• Du klärst medizinische Sachverhalte ab und leistest Zahlungen basierend auf gesetzlichen Vorgaben und Versicherungsverträgen

• Du verwaltest Regressansprüche gegen Dritte und andere Versicherer

Was du mitbringst

• Kaufmännische Grundausbildung im Versicherungsbereich oder ein Diplom im Sozialversicherungsbereich von Vorteil

• Erfahrung in der Bearbeitung von KTG

• Medizinische Erfahrung

• Hervorragende Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind von Vorteil

Dein Kontakt

Talent Acquisition Consultant: Silke Nachtigall (+41 44 628 20 59)

Zusätzliche Informationen

Teilzeit oder Vollzeit: 80 - 100%

Arbeitsort: Zürich, Oerlikon

Hybride s Arbeiten: bis zu 40 %

#LI-Hybrid

Wir freuen uns auf deine Onlinebewerbung – auch ohne Bewerbungsschreiben.
Gerne kannst du uns bei einem persönlichen Kennenlernen von deiner Motivation überzeugen.

Wer wir sind

Zurich ist eine starke Marke – mehr als 1,4 Millionen Schweizer Kundinnen und Kunden vertrauen auf unsere Produkte und Dienstleistungen. Die Basis unseres Erfolgs bilden unsere 53‘000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit, die unseren Kunden in 210 Ländern und Gebieten helfen, ihre Risiken besser zu verstehen und sich gegen diese zu schützen. Um die tägliche Leistung zu erbringen, bieten wir unseren Mitarbeitenden flexible Arbeitsmodelle und interessante Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten. Als Zurich-Mitarbeitender profitierst du von einer Vielzahl an Vorteilen und einer starken Kultur, geprägt von Akzeptanz, Vielfältigkeit und Teamorientierung.

Bei Zurich pflegen wir eine Kultur der Vielfalt und Inklusion. Unsere Ziele und Werte sind geschaffen, um unsere Mitarbeitenden zu schützen, Vertrauen zu fördern und zu helfen, ihr volles Potential auszuschöpfen. Wir stehen ein für Gerechtigkeit und Gleichheit unter unseren Angestellten, unabhängig vom Geschlecht, Geschlechtsidentität, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Religion, etc. Die Gewinnung unserer Talente sowie die Rekrutierungsprozesse spiegeln dieses Bekenntnis im Alltag. Steige bei uns ein und werde Teil dieser Kultur.

Weshalb ist Zurich seit über 150 Jahren erfolgreich? Siehe hier selbst und werde Teil davon .

Information für Personalvermittler

Zurich nimmt für diese Position keine unaufgeforderten Bewerbungen von Personalvermittlern entgegen. Personalvermittler reichen daher bitte keine Bewerberunterlagen an unsere Mitarbeitenden oder über unser Online-Karriere-Portal ein. Wir lehnen jegliche Verantwortung für unaufgefordert eingereichte Bewerbungen sowie etwaige Gebühren ab und danken für das Verständnis.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei entusiasta del trattamento dei reclami e vuoi svolgere un ruolo chiave nella gestione dei servizi per i dipendenti dei nostri clienti? Hai un talento per gestire più processi di reclamo in un ambiente dinamico, migliorando continuamente l'esperienza del nostro assicurato?

Nel nostro team di clienti KTG diversificato e multilingue, si lavora a stretto contatto con partner interni ed esterni e contribuire a garantire che i nostri clienti sono supportati in modo rapido e competente in caso di un servizio. Puoi aspettarti un ambiente di lavoro flessibile in cui puoi assumerti responsabilità, approfondire la tua esperienza e svilupparti personalmente e professionalmente.

Un servizio eccellente è buono solo come il team dietro di esso: Siamo alla ricerca di specialisti dedicati che sono appassionati di argomenti di cliente, vorrei lavorare in una squadra e far progredire la loro carriera a Zurigo Svizzera.

Scopri qui perché Zurigo Svizzera è uno dei datori di lavoro “Top 3” in Svizzera. Diventa parte di esso e applica come un team clienti Spzialist KTG.

Cosa fai

- Regola i servizi per le malattie dei dipendenti dei nostri clienti in conformità con le disposizioni legali e contrattuali

- Corrispondete e discutete con le varie parti coinvolte nel regolamento di reclamo (assicurato, datore di lavoro, servizio medico, altri assicuratori, avvocati)

- Si chiarisce le questioni mediche e si effettuano pagamenti in base ai requisiti legali e ai contratti di assicurazione

- Gestisci reclami di ricorso contro terzi e altri assicuratori

Cosa porti

- Istruzione di base commerciale nel settore assicurativo o diploma nel settore assicurativo sociale

- Esperienza nella lavorazione di KTG

- Esperienza medica

- Ottima capacità di comunicazione e negoziazione

- Molto buona conoscenza del tedesco nelle parole e nella scrittura, ulteriori competenze linguistiche sono vantaggiose

Il tuo contatto

Talent Acquisizione Consulente: Silke Nachtigall (+41 44 628 20 59)

Ulteriori informazioni

Tempo parziale o a tempo pieno: 80 - 100%

Luogo di lavoro: Zurigo, Oerlikon

Ibridi di lavoro: fino al 40%

#LI-Hybrid #

Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione online – anche senza una lettera di richiesta.
Siete invitati a convincerci della vostra motivazione durante un incontro personale.

Chi siamo

Zurigo è un marchio forte – più di 1,4 milioni di clienti svizzeri si affidano ai nostri prodotti e servizi. La base del nostro successo è la nostra 53.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo, che aiutano i nostri clienti in 210 paesi e territori a comprendere meglio e a proteggersi dai loro rischi. Al fine di fornire prestazioni quotidiane, offriamo ai nostri dipendenti modelli di lavoro flessibili e interessanti opportunità di formazione. Come dipendente di Zurigo, si beneficia di una moltitudine di vantaggi e di una forte cultura caratterizzata da accettazione, diversità e orientamento di squadra.

A Zurigo, coltiviamo una cultura della diversità e dell'inclusione. I nostri obiettivi e valori sono progettati per proteggere i nostri dipendenti, promuovere la fiducia e aiutarli a raggiungere il loro pieno potenziale. Siamo per la giustizia e l'uguaglianza tra i nostri dipendenti, indipendentemente dal sesso, identità di genere, orientamento sessuale, origine, etnia, religione, ecc. L'acquisizione dei nostri talenti e dei processi di reclutamento riflettono questo impegno nella vita quotidiana. Unisciti a noi e diventare parte di questa cultura.

Perché Zurigo ha avuto successo da oltre 150 anni? Vedere qui e diventare parte di esso.

Informazioni per i reclutatori

Zurigo non accetta applicazioni non richieste dai reclutatori per questa posizione. Pertanto, i reclutatori non inviano documenti candidati ai nostri dipendenti o tramite il nostro portale di carriera online. Rifiutiamo ogni responsabilità per applicazioni non richieste e qualsiasi commissione e ringraziamo per la vostra comprensione.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you enthusiastic about claims processing and would like to play a key role in handling services for our customers’ employees? Do you have a talent for managing multiple claims processes in a dynamic environment while continuously improving the experience of our insured?

In our diverse and multilingual customer team KTG, you work closely with internal and external partners and help ensure that our customers are supported quickly and competently in the event of a service. You can expect a flexible working environment in which you can take on responsibility, deepen your expertise and develop personally and professionally.

An excellent service is only as good as the team behind it: We are looking for dedicated specialists who are passionate about customer topics, would like to work in a team and advance their career at Zurich Switzerland.

Find out here why Zurich Switzerland is one of the “Top 3” employers in Switzerland. Become part of it and apply as a Spzialist customer team KTG.

What you do

- You regulate the services for illnesses of our customers' employees in accordance with the legal and contractual provisions

- You correspond and have discussions with the various parties involved in the claims settlement (insured, employer, medical service, other insurers, lawyers)

- You clarify medical matters and make payments based on legal requirements and insurance contracts

- You manage recourse claims against third parties and other insurers

What you bring

- Commercial basic education in the insurance sector or a diploma in the social insurance sector

- Experience in the processing of KTG

- Medical experience

- Excellent communication and negotiation skills

- Very good knowledge of German in words and writing, further language skills are advantageous

Your contact

Talent Acquisition Consultant: Silke Nachtigall (+41 44 628 20 59)

Additional information

Part-time or full-time: 80 - 100%

Place of work: Zurich, Oerlikon

Hybrids working: up to 40%

#LI-Hybrid

We look forward to your online application – even without an application letter.
You are welcome to convince us of your motivation during a personal meeting.

Who we are

Zurich is a strong brand – more than 1.4 million Swiss customers rely on our products and services. The basis of our success is our 53,000 employees worldwide, who help our customers in 210 countries and territories to better understand and protect themselves against their risks. In order to provide daily performance, we offer our employees flexible working models and interesting training opportunities. As a Zurich employee, you benefit from a multitude of advantages and a strong culture characterized by acceptance, diversity and team orientation.

At Zurich, we cultivate a culture of diversity and inclusion. Our goals and values are designed to protect our employees, promote trust and help them reach their full potential. We stand for justice and equality among our employees, regardless of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, origin, ethnicity, religion, etc. The acquisition of our talents and the recruitment processes reflect this commitment in everyday life. Join us and become part of this culture.

Why has Zurich been successful for more than 150 years? See here and become part of it.

Information for recruiters

Zurich does not accept unsolicited applications from recruiters for this position. Therefore, recruiters do not submit applicant documents to our employees or via our online career portal. We reject any responsibility for unsolicited applications and any fees and thank you for your understanding.

Êtes-vous enthousiaste au sujet du traitement des réclamations et aimeriez-vous jouer un rôle clé dans le traitement des services pour nos clients? Avez-vous un talent pour gérer plusieurs processus de réclamations dans un environnement dynamique tout en améliorant continuellement l'expérience de notre assuré?

Dans notre équipe client diversifiée et multilingue KTG, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec des partenaires internes et externes et vous aidez à assurer que nos clients sont soutenus rapidement et avec compétence en cas de service. Vous pouvez vous attendre à un environnement de travail flexible dans lequel vous pouvez assumer vos responsabilités, approfondir votre expertise et développer personnellement et professionnellement.

Un excellent service n'est qu'aussi bon que l'équipe qui l'accompagne : nous recherchons des spécialistes dévoués qui sont passionnés par les sujets clients, qui souhaitent travailler en équipe et faire avancer leur carrière à Zurich Suisse.

Découvrez ici pourquoi Zurich Suisse est l'un des employeurs du Top 3 de la Suisse. Devenez membre de l'équipe client Spzialist KTG.

- Vous réglementez les services pour les maladies des employés de nos clients conformément aux dispositions légales et contractuelles

- Vous correspondez et avez des discussions avec les différentes parties impliquées dans le règlement des réclamations (assuré, employeur, service médical, autres assureurs, avocats)

- Vous éclaircissez les questions médicales et effectuez les paiements en fonction des exigences légales et des contrats d'assurance

- Vous gérez les recours contre des tiers et d'autres assureurs

Ce que vous apportez

- Enseignement professionnel de base dans le secteur des assurances ou diplôme dans le secteur des assurances sociales

- Expérience dans le traitement de KTG

- Expérience médicale

- Excellentes compétences en communication et en négociation

- Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand en mots et en écriture, d'autres compétences linguistiques sont avantageuses

Votre contact

Consultant en acquisition de talents : Silke Nachtigall (+41 44 628 20 59)

Informations complémentaires

Temps partiel ou temps plein: 80 - 100%

Lieu de travail: Zurich, Oerlikon

Travail des hybrides: jusqu'à 40%

Nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature en ligne – même sans lettre de candidature.

Sei affascinato dal mondo degli esperti di veicoli e vorresti usare le tue abilità in un ambiente dinamico? In questo ruolo, hai l'opportunità di svolgere competenze digitali e creare opinioni di esperti sia in patria che all'estero. Determina le rotte di riparazione, determina i costi di danno e imposta i valori del veicolo – un'attività che richiede sia la precisione che il pensiero strategico. Con il tuo know-how, elabori casi di responsabilità aziendale e gestisci reclami di responsabilità, mentre allo stesso tempo negozia con assicurati, vittime e riparatori. Se si dispone di una forte attenzione al cliente e godere di lavorare con diversi stakeholder, questa è l'opportunità perfetta per voi di avanzare la vostra carriera.

Scopri qui perché Zurigo Svizzera è uno dei datori di lavoro “Top 3” in Svizzera. Diventa parte di esso e applicare come un esperto di veicolo in-house servizio.

Cosa fai

• Condurrai competenze digitali e genererai opinioni esperte basate su foto e video dei veicoli a motore sia per la casa che per l'estero

• Determina le rotte di riparazione, determina i costi di danno e imposta il valore del veicolo per garantire una gestione precisa ed efficiente dei danni

• Gestisci danni ai veicoli a motore (costi, reclami di responsabilità) e gestisci anche danni alla responsabilità aziendale, tenendo sempre conto degli interessi di tutte le parti coinvolte

• Controllate le bollette di riparazione, l'inferiorità e le richieste di riconoscimento per garantire la qualità e l'accuratezza delle fatture

• Si negozierà con gli assicurati, le vittime e i riparatori e coordinare il rimpatrio e il monitoraggio dei danni stranieri

Cosa porti

• Allenamento completato con successo come marinaio del corpo dell'automobile, pittore dell'automobile o ingegnere meccanico della meccatronica. Idealmente completato da ulteriore formazione come diagnostico automobilistico, coordinatore del workshop, direttore del workshop Carrosserie/Lack, commerciante tecnico o economista di affari laureato.

Questo ti dà una profonda esperienza e esperienza pratica nel settore della riparazione o nell'accettazione e nella lavorazione di veicoli danneggiati da incidenti.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione orale e digitale e un alto livello di affinità IT per consentire di sfruttare strumenti e tecnologie moderne.

• Molto buona conoscenza del tedesco è assolutamente necessario. Inoltre, hai una buona conoscenza di francese o italiano. Ulteriori competenze linguistiche sono vantaggiose e facilitano la comunicazione con diversi stakeholder.

Are you fascinated by the world of vehicle experts and would you like to use your skills in a dynamic environment? In this role, you have the opportunity to carry out digital expertise and create expert opinions both at home and abroad. You determine repair routes, determine damage costs and set vehicle values – an activity that requires both precision and strategic thinking. With your know-how, you process company liability claims cases and handle liability claims, while at the same time negotiating with policyholders, victims and repairers. If you have a strong customer focus and enjoy working with different stakeholders, this is the perfect opportunity for you to advance your career.

Find out here why Zurich Switzerland is one of the “Top 3” employers in Switzerland. Become part of it and apply as a vehicle expert in-house service.

What you do

• You will conduct digital expertise and generate expert opinions based on photos and videos of motor vehicles for both home and abroad

• You determine repair routes, determine the damage costs and set the vehicle value to ensure precise and efficient damage handling

• You handle motor vehicle damages (costs, liability claims) and also handle company liability damages, always taking into account the interests of all parties involved

• You check repair bills, inferiority and chômage claims to ensure the quality and accuracy of bills

• You will negotiate with policyholders, victims and repairers and coordinate the repatriation and monitoring of foreign damages

What you bring

• Successfully completed training as a car body sailor, car painter or automotive mechatronics engineer. Ideally supplemented by further training as an automotive diagnostician, workshop coordinator, workshop manager Carrosserie/Lack, technical merchant or graduated business economist.

• Several years of professional experience in Carrosserie repair, as workshop manager or customer service consultant. This gives you in-depth expertise and practical experience in the repair sector or in the acceptance and processing of accident-damaged vehicles.

• Strong oral and digital communication skills as well as a high level of IT affinity to enable you to leverage modern tools and technologies.

• Very good knowledge of German is absolutely necessary. In addition, you have good knowledge of French or Italian. Further language skills are beneficial and facilitate communication with different stakeholders.

• You are enthusiastic about direct contact with customers, are service-oriented and also approach solution-oriented in challenging situations.

Your contact

Hybrid work: up to 40%

In order to provide daily performance, we offer our employees flexible working models and interesting training opportunities. Zurigo Invest AG, responsabile patrimoniale svizzero di Zürich Versicherung AG, è una forza significativa e consolidata nel mercato svizzero con oltre 45 miliardi di franchi in attività gestionali ed è controllata dall'Autorità svizzera per la vigilanza sui mercati finanziari (FINMA). Con attualmente 38 specialisti, il team immobiliare svizzero gestisce un portafoglio immobiliare di oltre 13 miliardi di proprietà o circa 500 proprietà in 9 prodotti di investimento per tutto il ciclo di vita.

In qualità di rappresentante del cliente (m/f/d), sei responsabile per il soddisfacimento tecnico, economico e giuridico dei requisiti per i progetti di investimento da analisi potenziale alla consegna chiavi in mano e portare fornitori totali esterni, pianificatori o fornitori di servizi individuali.

Nell'ambito del team di prodotti, lavorerai a stretto contatto con il gestore patrimoniale e il gestore del portafoglio, e insieme, sulla base della strategia di prodotto e proprietà, definire la natura e la portata degli interventi di costruzione.

Scopri perché Zurigo è uno dei datori di lavoro "Top 3" della Svizzera. Entra a far parte di esso e applica come "Consigliere il rappresentante (m/f/d)".

Cosa fai

- Svilupperai potenziali analisi, valutazioni di fattibilità, analisi di mercato e localizzazione, nonché concetti per l'uso di varianti e definizioni di prodotto.

- L'utente effettua la due diligenza tecnica nel contesto delle transazioni e assicura che le opportunità e i rischi degli oggetti siano valutati in modo ben fondato.

- Pianifichi, organizzi e esegui incarichi di studio.

- Voi guidate lo sviluppo, la ristrutturazione e nuovi progetti di costruzione e rappresentate gli interessi di proprietà nelle autorità fiduciarie, nei confronti dei progettisti e delle aziende.

- Si assume la proprietà dell'amministrazione del progetto.

Cosa porti

- Università o laurea tecnica come architetto o un'istruzione equivalente con un'educazione immobiliare o aziendale

- Diversi anni di esperienza professionale nel mercato immobiliare svizzero e nella gestione di progetti di costruzione in tutte le fasi SIA

- Alta disponibilità a svolgere, comprensione rapida e uno stile di lavoro molto strutturato

- Talenti organizzativi con capacità di attuazione e di esecuzione

- Competenze francesi e tedesche eccellenti

Ulteriori informazioni

Chi siamo

Zurigo è un marchio forte – oltre 1,4 milioni di clienti svizzeri si affidano ai nostri prodotti e servizi. La base del nostro successo è la nostra 53.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo, che aiutano i nostri clienti in 210 paesi e territori a comprendere e proteggere meglio se stessi dai loro rischi. Al fine di fornire prestazioni quotidiane, offriamo ai nostri dipendenti modelli di lavoro flessibili e interessanti opportunità di formazione. Come dipendente di Zurigo, si beneficia di una moltitudine di vantaggi e di una forte cultura caratterizzata da accettazione, diversità e orientamento del team.

A Zurigo, coltiviamo una cultura della diversità e dell'inclusione. I nostri obiettivi e valori sono progettati per proteggere i nostri dipendenti, promuovere la fiducia e aiutarli a raggiungere il loro pieno potenziale. Siamo per la giustizia e l'uguaglianza tra i nostri dipendenti, indipendentemente dal sesso, identità di genere, orientamento sessuale, origine, etnia, religione, ecc. L'acquisizione dei nostri talenti e dei processi di reclutamento riflettono questo impegno nella vita quotidiana. Unisciti a noi e diventare parte di questa cultura.

Perché Zurigo ha avuto successo da oltre 150 anni? Vedere qui e diventare parte di esso.

Zurigo non accetta applicazioni non richieste dai reclutatori per questa posizione. Do you want to bring your broad expertise and experience to a professional, interdisciplinary team? Developing projects from scratch and helping to consistently implement our sustainability strategy?

Zurich Invest AG as the Swiss asset manager of Zürich Versicherung AG is a significant, well-established force in the Swiss market with over CHF 45 billion in assets under management and is supervised by the Swiss Financial Market Supervisory Authority (FINMA). With currently 38 specialists, the Swiss real estate team manages a real estate portfolio of over 13 billion properties or around 500 properties in 9 investment products over the entire life cycle.

As a client representative (m/f/d), you are responsible for the technical, economic and legal fulfilment of the requirements for investment projects from potential analysis to turnkey handover and lead external total contractors, planners or individual service providers.

As part of the product team, you will work closely with the asset manager and the portfolio manager, and together, based on the product and property strategy, define the nature and scope of the construction interventions.

Find out why Zurich is one of Switzerland's "Top 3" employers. Become part of it and apply as "Builder Representative (m/f/d)".

What you do

- You will develop potential analyses, feasibility assessments, market and location analyses as well as concepts for use variants and product definitions.

- You carry out the technical due diligence in the context of transactions and ensure that opportunities and risks of the objects are assessed in a well-founded manner.

- You plan, organize and carry out study assignments.

- You lead development, renovation and new construction projects and represent the interests of ownership in fiduciary vis-à-vis authorities, planners and companies.

- You take over the ownership of the project administration.

What you bring

- University or technical college degree as an architect or an equivalent education with a real estate or business education

- Several years of professional experience in the Swiss real estate market as well as in managing construction projects across all SIA phases

- High willingness to perform, quick comprehension and a very structured working style

- Organizational talent with implementation and enforcement capabilities

- Excellent French and German skills

Your contact

Senior Talent Acquisition Consultant: Jasmina Pipic (044 628 42 50)

Additional information

Part-time or full-time: 80 - 100%

Place of work: Zurich, Oerlikon

Travel activity: up to 20%

Hybrid work: up to 40%

#LI-Hybrid

We look forward to your online application – even without an application letter.
You are welcome to convince us of your motivation during a personal meeting.

Who we are

Zurich is a strong brand – more than 1.4 million Swiss customers rely on our products and services. The basis of our success is our 53,000 employees worldwide, who help our customers in 210 countries and territories to better understand and protect themselves against their risks. In order to provide daily performance, we offer our employees flexible working models and interesting training opportunities. As a Zurich employee, you benefit from a multitude of advantages and a strong culture characterized by acceptance, diversity and team orientation.

At Zurich, we cultivate a culture of diversity and inclusion. Our goals and values are designed to protect our employees, promote trust and help them reach their full potential. We stand for justice and equality among our employees, regardless of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, origin, ethnicity, religion, etc. The acquisition of our talents and the recruitment processes reflect this commitment in everyday life. Join us and become part of this culture.

Why has Zurich been successful for more than 150 years? See here and become part of it.

Information for recruiters

Zurich does not accept unsolicited applications from recruiters for this position. Therefore, recruiters do not submit applicant documents to our employees or via our online career portal. We reject any responsibility for unsolicited applications and any fees and thank you for your understanding.
