Zurich Invest AG en tant que gestionnaire d'actifs suisse de Zürich Versicherung AG est une force importante et bien établie sur le marché suisse avec plus de CHF 45 milliards d'actifs sous gestion et est supervisée par l'Autorité suisse de surveillance des marchés financiers (FINMA). Avec actuellement 38 spécialistes, l'équipe immobilière suisse gère un portefeuille immobilier de plus de 13 milliards de propriétés ou environ 500 propriétés dans 9 produits d'investissement sur toute la durée de vie.

En tant que représentant client (h/f/d), vous êtes responsable du respect technique, économique et juridique des exigences pour les projets d'investissement, de l'analyse potentielle au transfert clé en main et de la direction externe totale des entrepreneurs, planificateurs ou prestataires de services individuels.

Dans le cadre de l'équipe produit, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec le gestionnaire d'actifs et le gestionnaire de portefeuille, et ensemble, en fonction de la stratégie produit et propriété, définirez la nature et la portée des interventions de construction.

Découvrez pourquoi Zurich est l'un des meilleurs employeurs de Suisse. Devenez partie intégrante et appliquez-la en tant que « représentant de Builder (h/f/d) ».

- Vous développerez des analyses potentielles, des évaluations de faisabilité, des analyses de marché et de localisation ainsi que des concepts d'utilisation de variantes et de définitions de produits.

- Vous planifiez, organisez et réalisez des études.

- Vous dirigez des projets de développement, de rénovation et de construction et représentez les intérêts de la propriété fiduciaire vis-à-vis des autorités, des planificateurs et des entreprises.

- Vous prenez en charge l'administration du projet.

Ce que vous apportez

- Diplôme d'études universitaires ou techniques d'architecte ou d'enseignement équivalent dans le domaine de l'immobilier ou des affaires

- Plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle sur le marché immobilier suisse ainsi que dans la gestion de projets de construction à travers toutes les phases SIA

- Haute volonté de réaliser, compréhension rapide et un style de travail très structuré

- Compétences organisationnelles en matière de mise en œuvre et d ' application

- Excellentes compétences en français et en allemand

jobs.description:
Are you energized by solving complex IT challenges, and do you bring the emotional intelligence to navigate stakeholders across business, security, and engineering? Do you question the status quo and use your judgment to shape direction where best practice does not yet exist?

In the Engineering and Integration team, we connect what's separated, secure what matters, and reveal what's hidden, while shaping how integration, identity, and security work in a world of Agentic AI, hybrid delivery, and Zero Trust. We're modernising our identity platform around Keycloak, embedding Zero Trust and fine-grained authorization as the default, and building the identity foundations for an AI-augmented enterprise.

We’re looking for an experienced professional who leads through concepts, direction, and judgment, preparing Zurich Switzerland for what's next, by ensuring a future-ready, cost-efficient application landscape that scales as our business evolves - in an era where engineering value increasingly lies in judgment.

You'll work closely with our Senior Product Owner/Architect, Engineers, and Specialists, as the person who moves things forward, technologically, methodologically and conceptually.

We're an agile, collaborative team with a strong network across Business Unit Switzerland. Together with all IT departments, we combine deep technical expertise with a clear focus on delivery and outstanding service to our stakeholders.

If you love solving hard problems, communicate with clarity and empathy, and thrive in multidisciplinary teams, this role is exactly right for you.

Find out here why Zurich Switzerland is among the "Top 3" companies in Switzerland. Become a part of it and apply as Senior Platform Engineer – Identity & Security.

What you will do

• Set the technical direction for how our team engineers identity and security in an era where coding shifts toward becoming a commodity, through concepts, principles, and reference architectures that others in the team and beyond will build on and bring the team along on that journey

• Shape the evolution and operations of our Enterprise Identity Platform (strategic focus: Keycloak), including OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and PKCE, while steering the phase out of our legacy federation and extend our security posture into event-driven and AI-augmented workflows

• Develop and articulate the target picture for identity and security in the age of Agentic AI, from access management and security concepts for AI agents, agentic workflows, and workload identity, to fine-grained authorization (OpenFGA, OPA, Cedar) and Zero Trust

• Set engineering standards, reviews, and quality gates across internal teams, partners, and AI-augmented workflows - ensuring quality, security, and knowledge transfer

• Partner with business domains and Digital Products to translate insurance requirements into robust identity and security outcomes

What you bring

• 7 + years in software or security engineering - ideally in insurance, banking, or a related financial services industry - with deep expertise in modern authentication (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, PKCE, token lifecycle, federation, LDAP) and hands-on Keycloak experience

• Hands-on experience with Agentic AI access management and security concepts (agent identity, agent-to-agent auth, MCP security, prompt injection defense, supply chain security for AI components) and a critical eye for the limitations of AI-augmented development (Copilot, Claude, agentic workflows)

• Solid understanding of fine-grained authorization (OpenFGA, OPA, Cedar), Zero Trust, and cloud-native engineering (Azure and/or AWS, containers, event streaming)

• Strong sense of E2E ownership, business curiosity, ability to translate business intent into technical specifications, critical thinking and reflection, and ability to apply principles, name risks, surface trade-offs and manage ambiguity, paired with strong communication skills that earn trust and bring senior engineers along

• Fluent in English, both spoken and written, German is a plus

Your contact

Additional Information

Work location: Zurich, Oerlikon

Hybrid work: up to 40%

Sei eccitato risolvendo complesse sfide informatiche, e porti l'intelligenza emotiva a navigare le parti interessate attraverso il business, la sicurezza e l'ingegneria? Interrogate lo status quo e usate il vostro giudizio per modellare la direzione in cui la migliore pratica non esiste ancora?

Nel team di Ingegneria e Integrazione, colleghiamo ciò che è separato, assicuriamo ciò che conta, e riveliamo ciò che è nascosto, plasmando come l'integrazione, l'identità e la sicurezza lavorano in un mondo di AI Agentic, consegna ibrida e Zero Trust. Stiamo modernizzando la nostra piattaforma di identità intorno a Keycloak, incorporando Zero Trust e l'autorizzazione fine-grained come il default, e la costruzione delle basi di identità per un'impresa potenziata dall'IA.

Siamo alla ricerca di un professionista esperto che conduce attraverso concetti, direzione e giudizio, preparando la Svizzera di Zurigo per quello che è prossimo, assicurando un futuro-ready, economico paesaggio di applicazione che scala come il nostro business evolve - in un'epoca in cui il valore ingegneristico sempre più sta nel giudizio.

Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con il nostro Senior Product Owner/Architetto, Ingegneri e Specialisti, come la persona che muove le cose in avanti, tecnologicamente, metodologicamente e concettuale.

Siamo un team agile e collaborativo con una forte rete in Business Unit Svizzera. Insieme a tutti i dipartimenti IT, combiniamo competenze tecniche profonde con una chiara attenzione alla consegna e un servizio eccezionale ai nostri stakeholder.

Se amate risolvere problemi duri, comunicare con chiarezza ed empatia, e prosperare in team multidisciplinari, questo ruolo è esattamente giusto per voi.

Scoprite qui perché Zurigo Svizzera è tra le aziende "Top 3" in Svizzera. Diventa parte di esso e applica come Senior Platform Engineer – Identity & Security.

Cosa farai

- Impostare la direzione tecnica per come il nostro team ingegneri identità e sicurezza in un'epoca in cui la codifica si sposta verso diventare una merce, attraverso concetti, principi e architetture di riferimento che altri nel team e oltre costruiranno e porterà il team in quel viaggio

- Formare l'evoluzione e le operazioni della nostra piattaforma Enterprise Identity (centro strategico: Keycloak), tra cui OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML e PKCE, mentre guida la fase della nostra federazione legacy e estende la nostra postura di sicurezza in flussi di lavoro orientati agli eventi e potenziati dall'IA

- Sviluppare e articolare l'immagine di destinazione per l'identità e la sicurezza nell'era dell'Agenteic AI, dai concetti di gestione dell'accesso e sicurezza per gli agenti dell'AI, i flussi di lavoro agentici e l'identità del carico di lavoro, all'autorizzazione fine-grained (OpenFGA, OPA, Cedar) e Zero Trust

- Impostare standard di ingegneria, recensioni e porte di qualità in team interni, partner e flussi di lavoro potenziati dall'IA - garantire qualità, sicurezza e trasferimento di conoscenze

- Partner con domini aziendali e prodotti digitali per tradurre i requisiti assicurativi in risultati di identità e sicurezza robusti

Cosa porti

- 7 + anni di ingegneria del software o della sicurezza - idealmente in assicurazioni, banche o un settore dei servizi finanziari correlati - con profonda esperienza nell'autenticazione moderna (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, PKCE, ciclo di vita di token, federazione, LDAP) e esperienza di keycloak hands-on

- Esperienza pratica con i concetti di gestione dell'accesso dell'intelligenza artificiale e di sicurezza (identità di età, agente-a-agente a-agente auth, sicurezza MCP, pronta difesa dell'iniezione, sicurezza della supply chain per i componenti dell'IA) e un occhio critico per i limiti di sviluppo aumentata dell'IA (Copilota, Claude, flussi di lavoro agentici)

- Solida comprensione dell'autorizzazione in granito (OpenFGA, OPA, Cedar), Zero Trust e cloud-native engineering (Azure e/o AWS, container, streaming eventi)

- Forte senso di proprietà E2E, curiosità aziendale, capacità di tradurre l'intento di business in specifiche tecniche, pensiero critico e riflessione, e la capacità di applicare principi, rischi di nome, trade-off di superficie e gestire l'ambiguità, abbinato a forti capacità di comunicazione che guadagnano fiducia e portare ingegneri senior lungo

- Fluente in inglese, sia parlato che scritto, il tedesco è un plus

Il tuo contatto

Talent Acquisizione Consulente: Marco Stettler (+41 44 628 31 62)

Informazioni aggiuntive

Tempo pieno o part time: 80 – 100%

Luogo di lavoro: Zurigo, Oerlikon

Lavoro ibrido: fino al 40%

#LI-Hybrid #

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione online - anche senza una lettera di copertura.

Siete invitati a convincerci della vostra motivazione in un incontro personale.

Chi siamo

Zurigo è un marchio forte - oltre 1,4 milioni di clienti svizzeri si affidano ai nostri prodotti e servizi. I nostri 53.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo costituiscono la base del nostro successo, aiutando i nostri clienti in 210 paesi e territori a comprendere e proteggere se stessi dal rischio. Al fine di fornire i nostri servizi, offriamo ai nostri dipendenti modelli di lavoro flessibili e interessanti opportunità di ulteriore formazione e sviluppo. Come dipendente di Zurigo beneficiate di una moltitudine di vantaggi e di una cultura forte, caratterizzata da accettazione, diversità e spirito di squadra.

A Zurigo, adottiamo una cultura della diversità e dell'inclusione. Il nostro scopo e i nostri valori sono progettati per proteggere, ispirare la fiducia e aiutare i nostri dipendenti a raggiungere il loro pieno potenziale. Apprezziamo e difendiamo ciò che è giusto e promuoviamo opportunità di equità tra i nostri professionisti, indipendentemente dal sesso, dalla disabilità, LGBTQ +, gara, etnia, generazioni, fede, ecc. I nostri processi di acquisizione e assunzione di talenti rispettano ogni giorno questo impegno. Entra a Zurigo e partecipa a questa cultura.

Perché Zurigo ha avuto successo da oltre 150 anni? Date un'occhiata e diventate parte di esso.

L’idée de garantir à chaque étape du traitement d’un sinistre que nos clients bénéficient d’un interlocuteur compétent et fiable t’inspire et te motive ? Alors tu pourrais bien être la personne que nous recherchons.

Si tu es animé(e) par l’envie d’aider, que tu possèdes des qualités de leadership affirmées et que tu t’engages activement pour que ton équipe donne le meilleur d’elle-même, cette opportunité pourrait constituer une étape importante dans ta carrière.

Au sein du département Sinistres choses / RC, nous gérons l’ensemble des sinistres liés aux assurances de choses et de responsabilité civile pour nos clients privés et professionnels. En cas d’intempéries ou de catastrophes, la Task Force Grands Sinistres coordonne l’organisation et met immédiatement en œuvre les mesures nécessaires pour soutenir nos clients.

Dans ce contexte, tu rejoindras une équipe expérimentée et bien rodée, au sein de laquelle tu prendras, de manière autonome et responsable, la direction d’une équipe dédiée aux sinistres complexes dans la région de Crissier.

Découvre ici pourquoi Zurich Suisse fait partie du "Top 3" du prix du “Meilleur employeur” en Suisse. Deviens-en membre également et postule en tant que Responsable d’équipe sinistres complexes.

Ce que tu fais

• Tu es responsable de la gestion technique et tu conduis une équipe comptant jusqu’à 9 collaborateurs chargés du traitement complet des sinistres dans les domaines des assurances choses, responsabilité civile et techniques.

• Tu veilles à une gestion efficace des sinistres conformément aux directives et contribues activement à l’amélioration continue des processus.

• Tu assures la gestion opérationnelle au quotidien et garantis le bon déroulement des activités.

• Tu encourages le développement professionnel et personnel de chaque membre de ton équipe.

• Tu accompagnes activement ton équipe dans la mise en œuvre des changements.

Ce que tu apportes

• Brevet fédéral en assurance ou diplôme d’une école supérieure spécialisée en assurance.

• Min. 1-3 ans d’expérience en gestion d’équipe souhaitée.

• Plusieurs années d’expérience dans le règlement de sinistres et solides connaissances techniques dans les domaines des assurances choses et responsabilité civile.

• Esprit vif, forte orientation client, service et solutions.

• Excellente maîtrise du français et bonnes connaissances de l’allemand.

As an automotive expert on a large team in Switzerland, you assist our customers and injured persons in repairing damage quickly and without bureaucracy. Whether with a private car or a company car: the one on the way can count on Zurich.

If you live in the Lausanne region and have a high sense of responsibility associated with an ability to impose yourself and a great flexibility in relations with the various stakeholders complete your profile, then we look forward to your postulation.

- You perform motor vehicle assessments

- You determine the repair routes and calculate the amount of damage

- You are assessing the coverage and treatment of corporate liability claims

- You check repair invoices, losses and unemployment claims in collaboration with other Help Points and Disaster Centers

- You conduct negotiations with policyholders, injured persons and repair companies

What you bring

- Federal patent of motor vehicle mechatronician, carpenter or car painter OR equivalent training

- At least 5 years of professional experience in the repair sector or in the approval of vehicles damaged during an accident

- Very good knowledge of the MS-Office palette as well as systems related to repair

- Excellent mastery of French, both oral and written; good knowledge of English is an asset.

jobs.description:
The Finance Transformation is building a leading connected, collaborative Finance Function which is faster and more insight-driven. We will do this by transforming everything we do, every process, data and tool and injecting new ways of work and AI to amplify our Finance talent.

To support this ambition, Group Finance is launching the implementation of SAP Group Reporting Public Cloud, which is a key project within Finance Transformation.
We are looking for a Lead – Reporting Solution SAP Group Reporting. The role will be responsible for designing and deploying reporting solutions for SAP Group Reporting based on SAP Embedded Analytics, SAP Business Data Cloud and Data Bricks. Key Responsibilities are:

• Lead the reporting work stream within the wider SAP Group Reporting program, including design, build, testing and deployment to business users.

• Define the target reporting architecture for Group reporting.

• Design analytical views and reports that consume SAP Group Reporting data.

• Coordinate data integration between SAP Group Reporting, SAP Business Data Cloud and Databricks.

• Ensure that reporting solutions are accurate, controlled and aligned with Group Finance requirements (IFRS, management reporting, KPIs).

What you will do

• Define the target reporting architecture for SAP Group Reporting, leveraging SAP Embedded Analytics, SAP Business Data Cloud and Databricks.

• Design data views, virtual data models and semantic layers that provide a single source of truth for Group reporting.

• Translate business requirements into concrete reports, dashboards and analytical models

• Drive the build of:

• SAP Fiori / Embedded Analytics reports,

• Self‑service analytics via SAP Business Data Cloud

• Analytical models and data products in Databricks where needed.

• Coordinate data flows between SAP Group Reporting, Business Data Cloud and Databricks in close collaboration with IT and data teams.

• Run workshops with Group Finance, BU Finance and other stakeholders to capture and prioritise reporting needs

• Lead the Reporting Solution work stream within the wider SAP Group Reporting programme.

• Own the work stream plan, milestones, dependencies and risks; provide regular status updates to programme management.

• Coordinate design, build, SIT/UAT, and deployment activities for reporting solutions.

• Prepare cut‑over and handover to BAU, including documentation, training and support model.

• Define test strategy, test cases and acceptance criteria for reporting solutions.

• Coordinate test execution with Finance and IT, manage defects and ensure resolution before go‑live.

What you bring

• Practical experience with:

•

• SAP Embedded Analytics (e.g. CDS views, Fiori reporting),

• Cloud based data and analytics platforms (SAP Business Data Cloud, Databricks or similar).

• Hands on experience with SAP Group Reporting or comparable SAP consolidation / reporting tools (e.g. S/4HANA Finance, BPC, BW/4HANA).

• Strong experience in Group Reporting / consolidation and financial close processes (month end, quarter end, year end).

• Bachelor or Master in Finance or Finance/IT

• Proven track record leading a work stream or project in a finance / IT transformation programme.

• Experience in planning, tracking and delivering milestones, managing risks and dependencies.

• Strong stakeholder management skills, able to work effectively with Group Finance, BU Finance, IT, data teams and external partners.

• Experience with SIT/UAT, test case definition and defect management.

• Exposure to change management and handover to BAU (training, manuals, support processes).

• Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

• Experience working in complex, global programmes, preferably in the insurance or financial services sector.

• Strong collaboration skills and a “one team” attitude, supporting both Finance and IT colleagues.

You belong here.

Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus , you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.
You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple.
Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together.

About Us

Zurich is a leading multi-line insurer, serving over 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories with more than 65,000 employees.
For over 150 years, Zurich has been transforming insurance – offering not just protection, but also prevention services that promote well-being and climate resilience.
Guided by our purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ we aim to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world.

We look forward to receiving your online application today!

Information for recruitment agencies

Zurich does not accept any applications from recruitment agencies for this position. We refuse any responsibility for unsolicited applications, as well as any associated fees.

Why Zurich

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We are an equal opportunity employer who knows that each employee is unique - that’s what makes our team so great!
Join us as we constantly explore new way

Per sostenere questa ambizione, Group Finance lancia l'implementazione di SAP Group Reporting Public Cloud, che è un progetto chiave all'interno di Finance Transformation.
Stiamo cercando un Lead – Reporting Solution SAP Group Reporting. Il ruolo sarà responsabile della progettazione e distribuzione di soluzioni di reporting per SAP Group Reporting basate su SAP Embedded Analytics, SAP Business Data Cloud e Data Bricks. Le responsabilità chiave sono:

- Guida il flusso di lavoro di report all'interno del più ampio programma SAP Group Reporting, tra cui progettazione, costruzione, test e distribuzione agli utenti aziendali.

- Definire l'architettura di report target per il reporting di Gruppo.

- Progettare visioni analitiche e report che consumano i dati di SAP Group Reporting.

- Coordinate l'integrazione dei dati tra SAP Group Reporting, SAP Business Data Cloud e Databricks.

- Assicurarsi che le soluzioni di reporting siano accurate, controllate e allineate ai requisiti di Group Finance (IFRS, reporting gestionale, KPI).

Cosa farai

- Definire l'architettura di report target per SAP Group Reporting, sfruttando SAP Embedded Analytics, SAP Business Data Cloud e Databricks.

- Visualizzazione dei dati di progettazione, modelli di dati virtuali e strati semantici che forniscono un'unica fonte di verità per la segnalazione di Gruppo.

- Traduci i requisiti aziendali in rapporti concreti, dashboard e modelli analitici

- Guidare la costruzione di:

- SAP Fiori / rapporti di analisi incorporati,

- Analisi self-service tramite SAP Business Data Cloud

- Modelli analitici e prodotti dati in Databricks dove necessario.

- Coordinate i flussi di dati tra SAP Group Reporting, Business Data Cloud e Databricks in stretta collaborazione con team IT e dati.

- Eseguire workshop con Group Finance, BU Finance e altri stakeholder per catturare e dare priorità alle esigenze di reporting

- Guida il flusso di lavoro di Reporting Solution all'interno del più ampio programma SAP Group Reporting.

- Proprio il piano di flusso di lavoro, pietre miliari, dipendenze e rischi; fornire aggiornamenti regolari di stato alla gestione del programma.

- Coordinate le attività di progettazione, costruzione, SIT/UAT e distribuzione per le soluzioni di reporting.

- Preparare il taglio e la consegna a BAU, tra cui documentazione, formazione e modello di supporto.

- Definire la strategia di test, i casi di test e i criteri di accettazione per le soluzioni di reporting.

- Coordinare l'esecuzione del test con Finanza e IT, gestire i difetti e garantire la risoluzione prima di andare-live.

Cosa porti

- Esperienza pratica con:

-

- SAP Embedded Analytics (ad es. visualizzazioni CDS, reporting Fiori),

Questo ruolo sarà in grado di modellare il modo in cui i dati finanziari si spostano dai registri locali e dai sottosistemi attraverso livelli di integrazione nel motore di consolidamento, consentendo un processo affidabile e un reporting di Gruppo di alta qualità.

Cosa farai

- Definire l'architettura del flusso di dati di destinazione da registri e sottosistemi sorgente in SAP Group Reporting (comprese le fasi di mappatura, trasformazione e convalida).

- Assicurare soluzioni di supporto IFRS, GAAP locale e requisiti di reporting gestione.

- Coordinare i processi di estrazione, trasformazione e caricamento (ETL/ELT) dai sistemi sorgente al consolidamento.

- Migliorare la qualità dei dati con Finance, Group Accounting e IT (ad esempio risolvere lacune di dati, incongruenze, problemi di tempi).

- Progettazione e documento standardizzati processi di dati in entrata.

- Facilitare i workshop per chiarire i requisiti, allineare i tempi e risolvere i problemi interfunzionali.

- Comunicare gli impatti dei cambiamenti di sistema o di processo sui gruppi di reporting e sulle squadre di finanza locale.

- Guida il flusso di lavoro dei dati in entrata all'interno di più ampi programmi SAP Group Reporting / consolidamento.

- Piano e traccia flusso di lavoro consegnabili, pietre miliari, rischi e dipendenze.

- Coordinare test funzionali e tecnici (SIT, UAT) per interfacce e flussi di dati; gestire la risoluzione dei difetti.

- Sostenere la gestione dei cambiamenti, la formazione e la consegna alle squadre BAU.

Cosa porti

- Esperienza in SAP ECCS, SEM-BCS e/o SAP Group Reporting, almeno 5 anni di esperienza.

- Esperienza in SAP Public Cloud.

- Esperienza nella progettazione di SAP GRDC.

- Conoscenza nei processi di Contabilità del Gruppo con focus sul Consolidamento Finanziario.

- Corso di laurea o Master in Finanza o Finanza/IT.

This role will shape how financial data moves from local ledgers and sub systems through integration layers into the consolidation engine, enabling a reliable close process and high quality Group reporting.

What you will do

• Coordinate extraction, transformation and loading (ETL/ELT) processes from source systems to consolidation.

• Drive data quality improvements with Finance, Group Accounting, and IT (e.g. resolving data gaps, inconsistencies, timing issues).

• Design and document standardized inbound data processes.

• Facilitate workshops to clarify requirements, align timelines, and resolve cross-functional issues.

• Communicate impacts of system or process changes on Group Reporting and local finance teams.

• Lead the inbound data work stream within broader SAP Group Reporting / consolidation programs.

• Plan and track work stream deliverables, milestones, risks and dependencies.

• Coordinate functional and technical testing (SIT, UAT) for interfaces and data flows; manage defect resolution.

• Support change management, training and handover to BAU teams.

What you bring

• Experience in SAP ECCS, SEM-BCS and/or SAP Group Reporting, at least 5 years experience.

• Experience in SAP Public Cloud.

• Experience in designing SAP GRDC.

• Knowledgeable in Group Accounting processes with focus on Financial Consolidation.

• Bachelor or Master in Finance or Finance/IT.

• Understanding of SAP data structures (charts of accounts, ledgers, FS items, dimensions).

• Practical experience with interfaces/ETL, data mappings and reconciliations between source systems and consolidation tools.

• Experience in planning, tracking and delivering milestones, managing risks and dependencies.

• Ability to work effectively with Group Finance, BU Finance, IT, and external partners.

• Strong communication skills, able to translate between finance and technical teams.

• Experience with SIT/UAT, test case definition and defect management.

• Structured, analytical way of working with strong problem solving skills.

• High attention to detail and quality, especially regarding financial data.

Ce rôle façonnera la façon dont les données financières passent des registres et sous-systèmes locaux par des couches d'intégration dans le moteur de consolidation, permettant un processus de fermeture fiable et des rapports de groupe de haute qualité.

- Définir l'architecture de flux de données cible à partir des registres source et des sous-systèmes en reporting de groupe SAP (y compris les étapes de cartographie, de transformation et de validation).

- Diriger le flux de données entrantes dans le cadre des programmes de rapports et de consolidation du groupe SAP.

- Coordonner les essais fonctionnels et techniques (SIT, UAT) pour les interfaces et les flux de données; gérer la résolution des défauts.

- Connaissance des processus de comptabilité de groupe en mettant l'accent sur la consolidation financière.

- Compréhension des structures de données SAP (graphiques de comptes, registres, éléments FS, dimensions).

- Expérience pratique des interfaces/ETL, des cartes de données et des rapprochements entre les systèmes sources et les outils de consolidation.

- Expérience de la planification, du suivi et de la réalisation des jalons, de la gestion des risques et des dépendances.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La Trasformazione delle Finanze sta costruendo una funzione di finanza collegata e collaborativa che è più veloce e più orientata agli insight. Lo faremo trasformando tutto ciò che facciamo, ogni processo, dati e strumento e iniettando nuovi modi di lavoro e AI per amplificare il nostro talento Finance.

Il Business Solution Architect – Finance Transformation svolge un ruolo chiave nel flusso tecnologico, assicurando che Group Finance sfrutta le piattaforme giuste per i processi giusti – attraverso la pianificazione, il consolidamento, il reporting e l'analisi.

Questo ruolo senior tradurrà le esigenze aziendali in un'architettura integrata delle soluzioni, guiderà le scelte della piattaforma e aiuterà a garantire che strumenti come SAP Group Reporting, Anaplan e Databricks vengano utilizzati in modo efficace e coerente in tutto il Gruppo.

Cosa farai

- Definire ed evolvere l'architettura di soluzioni end to end per i processi di Group Finance (pianificazione, consolidamento, reporting, analisi e gestione delle prestazioni).

- Assicurarsi che ogni processo sia supportato dalla piattaforma più adatta (ad esempio SAP Group Reporting per il consolidamento, Anaplan per la pianificazione, Databricks per i dati e analisi), evitando duplicazioni e custom “shadow IT”.

- Traduci i requisiti in progetti di soluzione, modelli di integrazione e opzioni di implementazione, bilanciamento della standardizzazione, flessibilità e costi.

- Sfida e affina i requisiti aziendali per adattarsi alle funzionalità della piattaforma e ai principi di architettura a lungo termine.

- Definire come le piattaforme Finance integrano (SAP, Anaplan, Databricks, report/BI strumenti) per fornire dati coerenti e regolamentati per la pianificazione e la reportistica.

- Contribuire all'architettura dei dati Finance (domini dati, modelli, flussi, lineage) e garantire che i dati chiave (attuali, piani, scenari, KPI) siano gestiti come un'unica fonte di verità.

- Sostenere i processi di revisione e autorità di progettazione, assicurando nuove iniziative attenersi all'architettura concordata.

- Agire come lead Business Solution Architetto tra i principali progetti di trasformazione delle finanze e iniziative tecnologiche.

- Fornire una guida ai team di progetto sulle opzioni di soluzione, gli sconti e i rischi tecnici.

- Review key design artefatti (progetti di risoluzione, specifiche di interfaccia, modelli di dati) e risoluzione di problemi di supporto.

- Collabora a stretto contatto con la leadership Group Finance, BU Finance, Group IT, team di dati/analytics e proprietari di piattaforme

- Spiegare argomenti di architettura complessi in linguaggio aziendale chiaro e costruire il consenso sulle decisioni di progettazione.

- Contribuire alla comunicazione e all'istruzione sull'obiettivo

- Proporre miglioramenti all'architettura Finance, tra cui un migliore utilizzo di Anaplan e Databricks, standardizzazione dei dati e semplificazione del panorama del sistema.

Cosa porti

- Forte esperienza nei processi Finance / Group Finance, come pianificazione e previsione, consolidamento, reporting, gestione delle prestazioni o gestione dei capitali.

- Provato record di traccia in architettura di soluzione o ruoli senior business/IT design all'interno dei programmi di trasformazione Finance.

- Esperienza con piattaforme di finanza SAP (ad esempio S/4HANA Finance, SAP Group Reporting) e il loro ruolo nel reporting di Gruppo.

- La conoscenza di Anaplan e Databricks è un forte vantaggio.

The Business Solution Architect – Finance Transformation plays a key role in the technology stream, ensuring that Group Finance leverages the right platforms for the right processes – across planning, consolidation, reporting and analytics.

This senior role will translate business needs into an integrated solution architecture, guide platform choices and help ensure that tools such as SAP Group Reporting, Anaplan and Databricks are used effectively and consistently across the Group.

What you will do

• Define how Finance platforms integrate (SAP, Anaplan, Databricks, reporting/BI tools) to deliver consistent, governed data for planning and reporting.

• Propose improvements to the Finance architecture, including better use of Anaplan and Databricks, standardisation of data and simplification of the system landscape.

What you bring

• Strong experience in Finance / Group Finance processes, such as planning and forecasting, consolidation, reporting, performance management or capital management.

• Proven track record in solution architecture or senior business/IT design roles within Finance transformation programmes.

• Experience with SAP finance platforms (e.g. S/4HANA Finance, SAP Group Reporting) and their role in Group reporting.

descriptionByLocale.en:
(This is a temporary contract till 31.12.2027)

The Finance Transformation is building a leading connected, collaborative Finance Function which is faster and more insight-driven. We will do this by transforming everything we do, every process, data and tool and injecting new ways of work and AI to amplify our Finance talent.

The BA/SME Databricks will play a key role in the technology stream, focusing on business analysis and subject matter expertise to ensure that Databricks is leveraged as defined in the target architecture and roadmap.

This role will work on processes, options and business cases to use Databricks for Finance data integration, analytics and data products, and the role will help Finance teams understand when and how to use Databricks versus other platforms.

What you will do

• Work with Group Finance, BU Finance and data/analytics teams to identify and refine use cases for Databricks (e.g. finance data pipelines, advanced analytics, scenario analysis, data products.

• Gather and challenge business requirements and translate them into clear functional specifications for Databricks solutions.

• Assess which requirements should be implemented on Databricks vs. other platforms (SAP, Anaplan, BI tools), in line with the Finance technology strategy.

• Define and document Finance processes that rely on Databricks (e.g. data preparation for reporting, modelling workflows, analytics).

• Contribute to the Databricks operating model for Finance: roles, responsibilities, ways of working with Group IT / data platform teams.

• Evaluate solution options for Finance needs.

• Develop business cases for Databricks initiatives, including benefits (data quality, automation, speed, insight), effort and cost.

• Support prioritisation of Databricks use cases within the Finance Transformation roadmap.

• Translate business needs/requirements into user stories, acceptance criteria.

• Define test cases and acceptance criteria for Databricks solutions from a Finance perspective.

• Coordinate UAT with Finance users, manage defects and support resolution.

• Ensure Databricks initiatives remain aligned with the target Finance technology and data architecture defined by the Business Solution Architects.

What you bring

• Experience as Business Analyst or SME in Finance, data or analytics projects.

• Good understanding of Finance / Group Finance processes.

• Practical experience with data platforms or analytics environments; hands on exposure to Databricks is a strong advantage.

• Familiarity with concepts such as data pipelines, data modelling, data products, and analytics/BI.

• Experience working with IT / data engineering teams on shared solutions.

• Strong requirements gathering and documentation skills.

• Ability to analyse solution options and build business cases in a clear, structured way.

• Structured, analytical and solution oriented mindset.

• Ability to simplify complexity and communicate clearly to non technical audiences.

• Experience working in complex, global programmes, preferably in the insurance or financial services sector.

• Strong collaboration skills and a “one team” attitude, supporting both Finance and IT colleagues.

• Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages are an advantage.

You belong here.

Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus , you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.

You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple.

Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together.

About Us

Zurich is a leading multi-line insurer, serving over 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories with more than 65,000 employees.

For over 150 years, Zurich has been transforming insurance – offering not just protection, but also prevention services that promote well-being and climate resilience.
Guided by our purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ we aim to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world.

We look forward to receiving your online application today!

Information for recruitment agencies

Zurich does not accept any applications from recruitment agencies for this position. We refuse any responsibility for unsolicited applications, as well as any associated fees.

Why Zurich

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We are an equal opportunity employer who knows that each employee is unique - that’s what makes our team so great!
Join us as we constantly explore new ways to protect our customers and the planet .

jobs.description:
Zurich Insurance is on an exciting journey to become a truly customer led organization.

Zurich’s Group Customer Office is playing a pivotal role on that journey and is involved in a broad range of activities - working with all our regions and markets across the globe to shape the customer agenda.

To support this effort, we are looking for a passionate, data-driven, and innovative insights expert to join our Customer, Market & Brand Insights team. This role is paramount in evaluating our brand health and customer experience through our continuous Global Brand tracking study and Relationship NPS studies that inform decision making across 20+ markets and at every level of the business. These fundamental studies enable us to diagnose brand perceptions and deep dive into the customer experience (CX) shaping future strategies and improving how we deliver against customer needs. Working closely with local markets, as well as regional management and other Group functions, this role will include planning, delivery and evolving these tools to ensure data-based insights are generated to influence business decisions and actions. As the volume and volume and complexity of data grows, we’re evolving how we work - embracing AI tools to accelerate data processing and transform how insight is presented to the business. Our intention is to spend less time on production and more time on interpretation, implementation and communication that drives action.

Reporting to the Head of Global Brand Tracking & NPS, the candidate’s key responsibilities will focus on consistently delivering these important insights platforms, so they evolve with the business needs and drive change.

What you will do

• Act as customer champion, raising awareness, providing guidance and training to the organization on key dimensions and insights of our program to drive actions.

• Take ownership of the two continuous global studies and ad hoc retail RNPS studies ensuring smooth project management and delivery of robust and relevant data and KPIs into the business.

• Apply AI and emerging technology to insight work to increase efficiency in data processing, synthesis and reporting, enabling shaper focus on interpretation, narrative and business implication.

• Define, evolve and conduct global studies, coordinating between multitude of markets and partnering with the respective agency.

• Analyze feedback, derive insight, report and present to stakeholders across the organization, including senior management at global, regional and local level.

• Drive the combination of data sources to strengthen relevance to decision making and impact on performance e.g. correlation analysis linking customer experience with financials.

• Ensure programs are technically strong and appropriate from questionnaire development, sample, weighting rules, and data uploads building confidence in the tool’s robustness.

• Translate analytic insights into concrete actionable recommendations, drawing conclusions for business improvement and influencing strategy effectively, including workshop facilitation.

• Maintain and promote our data hosting platform to democratize insights across the business.

• Manage external research agencies and budgets.

• Input support to Senior Insight Manager in identifying, communicating and activating insights.

• Keep up with best practice in the field and transfer relevant topics into Zurich’s programs.

Work location is Zurich with travel potentially required up to 10%

What you bring

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree (e.g., in business studies/administration, research, data science, psychology, behaviour science, customer or change management), 5+ years of experience in managing insights to actions programs.

• Expertise in managing customer research as part of an in-house customer insight team or as part of a consulting practice, ideally coupled with solid expertise in NPS and/or brand tracking methodology.

• A curiosity and experience exploring or applying AI tools in a research/insight context (e.g. verbatim analysis, automated reporting, cross market synthesis).

• Passionate and curious about data analysis & identifying insights to facilitate action planning.

• Program management and coordination skills to build and drive studies across 19+ markets including managing study preparation and execution (e.g. study set up and design, sampling strategy definition, execution, reporting), driving alignment between markets and ensuring global study framework is applied and adhered to.

• Ability to work with larger sets of data (Excel, SPSS) to provide additional/ad-hoc analysis (creating cuts of data based on different stakeholder requirements in addition to agency results packs).

• Experience in working with markets across the globe as well as ability to build and manage relationships across different cultural clusters.

• Strong analytical, (insights) writing/communications as well as workshop facilitation skills.

• Ability to guide virtual teams, e.g., establish and run global VOC community.

• Solid knowledge of insurance market, operations, products and services.

• Working language is primarily English.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'assicurazione di Zurigo è in un viaggio emozionante per diventare un'organizzazione veramente orientata al cliente.

Il Customer Office del Gruppo di Zurigo sta svolgendo un ruolo fondamentale in questo viaggio ed è coinvolto in una vasta gamma di attività - lavorando con tutte le nostre regioni e mercati in tutto il mondo per plasmare l’agenda del cliente.

Per sostenere questo sforzo, siamo alla ricerca di un esperto appassionato, guidato dai dati e innovativo per unire il nostro team Customer, Market & Brand Insights. Questo ruolo è fondamentale nella valutazione della nostra salute del marchio e dell'esperienza del cliente attraverso il nostro continuo studio di monitoraggio del marchio globale e studi di relazione NPS che informano il processo decisionale attraverso 20+ mercati e ad ogni livello del business. Questi studi fondamentali ci permettono di diagnosticare le percezioni del marchio e immergerci profondamente nell'esperienza del cliente (CX) modellando le strategie future e migliorando il modo in cui forniamo contro le esigenze del cliente. Lavorando a stretto contatto con i mercati locali, così come la gestione regionale e altre funzioni del Gruppo, questo ruolo includerà la pianificazione, la consegna e l'evoluzione di questi strumenti per garantire che le informazioni basate sui dati siano generate per influenzare le decisioni e le azioni aziendali. Man mano che cresce il volume e il volume e la complessità dei dati, stiamo evolvendo il nostro modo di lavorare - abbracciando gli strumenti AI per accelerare il trattamento dei dati e trasformare il modo in cui viene presentata l'intuizione al business. La nostra intenzione è quella di trascorrere meno tempo sulla produzione e più tempo sull'interpretazione, l'implementazione e la comunicazione che spingono l'azione.

Segnalandosi al capo di Global Brand Tracking & NPS, le responsabilità chiave del candidato si concentreranno sulla fornitura coerente di queste importanti piattaforme di insight, in modo da evolversi con le esigenze aziendali e il cambiamento di unità.

Cosa farai

- Agire come campione del cliente, sensibilizzare, fornire guida e formazione all'organizzazione su dimensioni chiave e approfondimenti del nostro programma per guidare le azioni.

- Prendere la proprietà dei due studi globali continui e gli studi RNPS di vendita al dettaglio ad hoc assicurando la gestione e la consegna di dati robusti e rilevanti e KPI nel business.

- Applicare l'IA e la tecnologia emergente per approfondire il lavoro per aumentare l'efficienza nell'elaborazione dei dati, nella sintesi e nel reporting, consentendo al shaper di focalizzarsi sull'interpretazione, sulla narrazione e sull'implicazione aziendale.

- Definire, evolvere e condurre studi globali, coordinare tra moltitudine di mercati e collaborare con la rispettiva agenzia.

- Analizzare il feedback, trarre comprensione, rapporto e presente agli stakeholder di tutta l'organizzazione, tra cui la gestione senior a livello globale, regionale e locale.

- Guidare la combinazione di fonti di dati per rafforzare la rilevanza al processo decisionale e l'impatto sulle prestazioni, ad esempio analisi di correlazione che collegano l'esperienza del cliente con i finanziamenti.

- Assicurare che i programmi siano tecnicamente forti e appropriati dallo sviluppo del questionario, dalle regole di campionamento, di ponderazione e dai upload dei dati che creano fiducia nella robustezza dello strumento.

- Tradurre intuizioni analitiche in raccomandazioni attuabili concrete, trarre conclusioni per il miglioramento del business e influenzare efficacemente la strategia, compresa la facilitazione del workshop.

- Mantenere e promuovere la nostra piattaforma di hosting dati per democratizzare le informazioni in tutto il business.

- Gestire agenzie di ricerca esterne e budget.

- Supporto di input a Senior Insight Manager per identificare, comunicare e attivare le informazioni.

- Continua a praticare nel campo e trasferisci argomenti rilevanti nei programmi di Zurigo.

La posizione di lavoro è Zurigo con un viaggio potenzialmente richiesto fino al 10%

Cosa porti

- Corso di laurea o master (ad esempio, negli studi aziendali/amministrazione, ricerca, scienza dei dati, psicologia, scienza del comportamento, gestione del cliente o del cambiamento), 5+ anni di esperienza nella gestione delle intuizioni ai programmi di azioni.

- Competenza nella gestione della ricerca dei clienti nell'ambito di un team di intuizione clienti interno o nell'ambito di una pratica di consulenza, idealmente accoppiata con solida competenza in NPS e/o nella metodologia di tracciamento del marchio.

- Una curiosità e un'esperienza che esplorano o applicano gli strumenti AI in un contesto di ricerca/insight (ad esempio analisi verbatim, reporting automatizzato, sintesi cross market).

- Appassionato e curioso dell'analisi dei dati e dell'individuazione di approfondimenti per facilitare la pianificazione delle azioni.

- Gestione del programma e competenze di coordinamento per costruire e guidare gli studi in 19+ mercati, tra cui la gestione della preparazione e dell'esecuzione dello studio (ad esempio, l'allestimento di studio e la progettazione, la definizione di strategia di campionamento, l'esecuzione, la segnalazione), l'allineamento di guida tra i mercati e garantire il quadro di studio globale è applicato e aderente.

- Esperienza nel lavorare con i mercati in tutto il mondo, nonché la capacità di costruire e gestire le relazioni in diversi cluster culturali.

- Forte analitica, (insights) scrittura/comunicazioni, così come competenze di facilitazione del laboratorio.

- Capacità di guidare squadre virtuali, ad esempio, stabilire ed eseguire la comunità globale di VOC.

- Conoscenza solida del mercato assicurativo, delle operazioni, dei prodotti e dei servizi.

Tu appartieni qui.

Guidato dal nostro scopo di “creare un futuro più luminoso insieme”, ci proponiamo di essere una delle aziende più responsabili e d’impatto al mondo.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Zurich Insurance is on an exciting journey to become a truly customer led organization.

Zurich’s Group Customer Office is playing a pivotal role on that journey and is involved in a broad range of activities - working with all our regions and markets across the globe to shape the customer agenda.

To support this effort, we are looking for a passionate, data-driven, and innovative insights expert to join our Customer, Market & Brand Insights team. This role is paramount in evaluating our brand health and customer experience through our continuous Global Brand tracking study and Relationship NPS studies that inform decision making across 20+ markets and at every level of the business. These fundamental studies enable us to diagnose brand perceptions and deep dive into the customer experience (CX) shaping future strategies and improving how we deliver against customer needs. Working closely with local markets, as well as regional management and other Group functions, this role will include planning, delivery and evolving these tools to ensure data-based insights are generated to influence business decisions and actions. As the volume and volume and complexity of data grows, we’re evolving how we work - embracing AI tools to accelerate data processing and transform how insight is presented to the business. Our intention is to spend less time on production and more time on interpretation, implementation and communication that drives action.

Reporting to the Head of Global Brand Tracking & NPS, the candidate’s key responsibilities will focus on consistently delivering these important insights platforms, so they evolve with the business needs and drive change.

What you will do

• Act as customer champion, raising awareness, providing guidance and training to the organization on key dimensions and insights of our program to drive actions.

• Take ownership of the two continuous global studies and ad hoc retail RNPS studies ensuring smooth project management and delivery of robust and relevant data and KPIs into the business.

• Apply AI and emerging technology to insight work to increase efficiency in data processing, synthesis and reporting, enabling shaper focus on interpretation, narrative and business implication.

• Define, evolve and conduct global studies, coordinating between multitude of markets and partnering with the respective agency.

• Analyze feedback, derive insight, report and present to stakeholders across the organization, including senior management at global, regional and local level.

• Drive the combination of data sources to strengthen relevance to decision making and impact on performance e.g. correlation analysis linking customer experience with financials.

• Ensure programs are technically strong and appropriate from questionnaire development, sample, weighting rules, and data uploads building confidence in the tool’s robustness.

• Translate analytic insights into concrete actionable recommendations, drawing conclusions for business improvement and influencing strategy effectively, including workshop facilitation.

• Maintain and promote our data hosting platform to democratize insights across the business.

• Manage external research agencies and budgets.

• Input support to Senior Insight Manager in identifying, communicating and activating insights.

• Keep up with best practice in the field and transfer relevant topics into Zurich’s programs.

Work location is Zurich with travel potentially required up to 10%

What you bring

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree (e.g., in business studies/administration, research, data science, psychology, behaviour science, customer or change management), 5+ years of experience in managing insights to actions programs.

• Expertise in managing customer research as part of an in-house customer insight team or as part of a consulting practice, ideally coupled with solid expertise in NPS and/or brand tracking methodology.

• A curiosity and experience exploring or applying AI tools in a research/insight context (e.g. verbatim analysis, automated reporting, cross market synthesis).

• Passionate and curious about data analysis & identifying insights to facilitate action planning.

• Program management and coordination skills to build and drive studies across 19+ markets including managing study preparation and execution (e.g. study set up and design, sampling strategy definition, execution, reporting), driving alignment between markets and ensuring global study framework is applied and adhered to.

• Ability to work with larger sets of data (Excel, SPSS) to provide additional/ad-hoc analysis (creating cuts of data based on different stakeholder requirements in addition to agency results packs).

• Experience in working with markets across the globe as well as ability to build and manage relationships across different cultural clusters.

• Strong analytical, (insights) writing/communications as well as workshop facilitation skills.

• Ability to guide virtual teams, e.g., establish and run global VOC community.

• Solid knowledge of insurance market, operations, products and services.

• Working language is primarily English.

You belong here.

Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus , you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.

You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Zurich Insurance ist auf einer aufregenden Reise, um eine wirklich kundengeführte Organisation zu werden.

Das Group Customer Office von Zurich spielt auf diesem Weg eine zentrale Rolle und ist an einer breiten Palette von Aktivitäten beteiligt - gemeinsam mit allen unseren Regionen und Märkten auf der ganzen Welt, um die Kundenagenda zu gestalten.

Um diese Bemühungen zu unterstützen, suchen wir nach einem leidenschaftlichen, datengesteuerten und innovativen Experten, der sich unserem Customer, Market & Brand Insights-Team anschließt. Diese Rolle ist von größter Bedeutung für die Bewertung unserer Markengesundheit und Kundenerfahrung durch unsere kontinuierliche Global Brand Tracking-Studie und Relationship NPS-Studien, die die Entscheidungsfindung in über 20 Märkten und auf jeder Ebene des Unternehmens beeinflussen. Diese grundlegenden Studien ermöglichen es uns, Markenwahrnehmungen zu diagnostizieren und tief in die Customer Experience (CX) einzutauchen, um zukünftige Strategien zu gestalten und zu verbessern, wie wir den Kundenbedürfnissen gerecht werden. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit lokalen Märkten sowie dem regionalen Management und anderen Gruppenfunktionen wird diese Rolle die Planung, Bereitstellung und Weiterentwicklung dieser Tools umfassen, um sicherzustellen, dass datenbasierte Erkenntnisse generiert werden, um Geschäftsentscheidungen und -maßnahmen zu beeinflussen. Da das Volumen und das Volumen und die Komplexität der Daten zunehmen, entwickeln wir unsere Arbeitsweise weiter und nutzen KI-Tools, um die Datenverarbeitung zu beschleunigen und die Art und Weise, wie die Erkenntnisse dem Unternehmen präsentiert werden, zu verändern. Unsere Absicht ist es, weniger Zeit für die Produktion und mehr Zeit für die Interpretation, Umsetzung und Kommunikation zu verwenden, die das Handeln antreibt.

Die Hauptverantwortlichkeiten des Kandidaten werden sich bei der Berichterstattung an den Head of Global Brand Tracking & NPS darauf konzentrieren, diese wichtigen Insights-Plattformen konsequent bereitzustellen, damit sie sich mit den Geschäftsanforderungen weiterentwickeln und Veränderungen vorantreiben.

Was du tun wirst

- Handeln Sie als Customer Champion, schärfen Sie das Bewusstsein, bieten Sie Anleitung und Schulung für das Unternehmen zu Schlüsseldimensionen und Erkenntnissen unseres Programms, um Maßnahmen voranzutreiben.

- Übernehmen Sie die beiden kontinuierlichen globalen Studien und Ad-hoc-RNPS-Studien für den Einzelhandel, die ein reibungsloses Projektmanagement und die Bereitstellung robuster und relevanter Daten und KPIs in das Unternehmen gewährleisten.

- Wenden Sie KI und neue Technologien auf Einblicke an, um die Effizienz bei der Datenverarbeitung, -synthese und -berichterstattung zu erhöhen, sodass sich Shaper auf Interpretation, Erzählung und Geschäftsauswirkungen konzentrieren können.

- Definieren, entwickeln und führen Sie globale Studien durch, koordinieren Sie die Vielzahl von Märkten und arbeiten Sie mit der jeweiligen Agentur zusammen.

- Analyse von Feedback, Ableitung von Erkenntnissen, Berichterstattung und Präsentation für Stakeholder in der gesamten Organisation, einschließlich der Geschäftsleitung auf globaler, regionaler und lokaler Ebene.

- Führen Sie die Kombination von Datenquellen voran, um die Relevanz für die Entscheidungsfindung und die Auswirkungen auf die Leistung zu stärken, z. B. Korrelationsanalysen, die die Kundenerfahrung mit Finanzen verknüpfen.

- Stellen Sie sicher, dass Programme technisch stark und angemessen sind, indem Sie Fragebogenentwicklung, Stichproben, Gewichtungsregeln und Datenuploads erstellen und Vertrauen in die Robustheit des Tools aufbauen.

- Übersetzen Sie analytische Einblicke in konkrete umsetzbare Empfehlungen, ziehen Sie Schlussfolgerungen für Geschäftsverbesserungen und beeinflussen Sie die Strategie effektiv, einschließlich Workshop-Modernisierung.

- Pflegen und fördern Sie unsere Daten-Hosting-Plattform, um Erkenntnisse im gesamten Unternehmen zu demokratisieren.

- Verwalten Sie externe Forschungsagenturen und Budgets.

- Input-Unterstützung für Senior Insight Manager bei der Identifizierung, Kommunikation und Aktivierung von Insights.

- Bleiben Sie mit Best Practice im Feld Schritt und übertragen Sie relevante Themen in die Programme von Zurich.

Arbeitsstandort ist Zürich mit Reisen potenziell bis zu 10% erforderlich

Was du mitbringst

- Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss (z. B. in Betriebswirtschaftslehre / Verwaltung, Forschung, Data Science, Psychologie, Verhaltenswissenschaft, Kunden- oder Change-Management), 5+ Jahre Erfahrung im Management von Insights zu Aktionsprogrammen.

- Expertise im Management von Kundenrecherchen als Teil eines internen Customer Insight Teams oder als Teil einer Beratungspraxis, idealerweise gepaart mit solider Expertise in NPS und/oder Brand Tracking Methodik.

- Eine Neugier und Erfahrung in der Erforschung oder Anwendung von KI-Tools in einem Forschungs- / Einblickskontext (z. B. Verbatim-Analyse, automatisiertes Reporting, marktübergreifende Synthese).

- Leidenschaftlich und neugierig auf Datenanalyse und die Identifizierung von Erkenntnissen zur Erleichterung der Handlungsplanung.

- Programmmanagement- und Koordinationsfähigkeiten zum Aufbau und zur Förderung von Studien in über 19 Märkten, einschließlich der Verwaltung der Studienvorbereitung und -durchführung (z. B. Einrichtung und Gestaltung von Studien, Festlegung von Stichprobenstrategien, Ausführung, Berichterstattung), Förderung der Ausrichtung zwischen den Märkten und Sicherstellung eines globalen Studienrahmens wird angewendet und eingehalten.

- Möglichkeit, mit größeren Datensätzen (Excel, SPSS) zu arbeiten, um zusätzliche / Ad-hoc-Analysen bereitzustellen (Erstellen von Datenschnitten basierend auf verschiedenen Stakeholder-Anforderungen zusätzlich zu den Ergebnissen der Agentur).

- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Märkten auf der ganzen Welt sowie die Fähigkeit, Beziehungen zwischen verschiedenen kulturellen Clustern aufzubauen und zu verwalten.

- Starke analytische, (Insights) Schreiben / Kommunikation sowie Workshop Facilitation Fähigkeiten.

- Fähigkeit, virtuelle Teams zu führen, z. B. globale VOC-Community aufzubauen und zu betreiben.

- Solides Wissen über Versicherungsmarkt, Operationen, Produkte und Dienstleistungen.

- Arbeitssprache ist in erster Linie Englisch.

Du gehörst hierher.

Stellen Sie sich vor, Sie arbeiten an einem der nachhaltigsten Arbeitsplätze der Welt. Auf dem Quai Zürich Campus genießen Sie eine Umgebung, die Ihnen helfen soll, zu gedeihen, mit Vorteilen, die Ihr Wohlbefinden und Ihre Wirkung unterstützen, und Möglichkeiten, Ihre besten Leistungen zu erbringen, umgeben von Top-Talenten und unterstützenden Kollegen.

Sie haben Zugang zu gesunden Nahrungsmitteln, Fitnesseinrichtungen und hellen, kollaborativen Räumen, die Kreativität auslösen. Im Herzen von Zürich am Ufer des Zürichsees gelegen, bietet der Campus eine hervorragende Anbindung an die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel, die Ihren Weg zur Arbeit vereinfachen.

Wachsen Sie mit uns durch den Zugang zu Lernressourcen, On-the-Job-Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Ermächtigung und Unterstützung. Seien Sie Teil eines Teams, das gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft schafft.

Über uns

Zurich ist ein führender Multiline-Versicherer, der über 82 Millionen Kunden in mehr als 200 Ländern und Regionen mit mehr als 65.000 Mitarbeitern betreut.

Seit über 150 Jahren verändert Zürich die Versicherung – und bietet nicht nur Schutz, sondern auch Präventionsleistungen, die Wohlbefinden und Klimaresistenz fördern.

Geleitet von unserem Ziel, gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft zu schaffen, wollen wir eines der verantwortungsvollsten und wirkungsvollsten Unternehmen der Welt sein.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Online-Bewerbung noch heute!
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Zurich Assurance est sur un voyage passionnant pour devenir une organisation vraiment dirigée par le client.

Le bureau client du Groupe Zurich joue un rôle central dans ce parcours et participe à un large éventail d'activités - en travaillant avec toutes nos régions et tous nos marchés à travers le monde pour façonner l'agenda client.

Pour soutenir cet effort, nous recherchons un expert passionné, axé sur les données et innovant pour rejoindre notre équipe client, Market & Brand Insights. Ce rôle est primordial dans l'évaluation de notre santé de marque et de notre expérience client grâce à notre étude continue de suivi de la marque mondiale et des études NPS Relations qui éclairent la prise de décision sur plus de 20 marchés et à tous les niveaux de l'entreprise. Ces études fondamentales nous permettent de diagnostiquer les perceptions de marque et de plonger profondément dans l'expérience client (CX) façonnant les stratégies futures et améliorant notre façon de répondre aux besoins des clients. Travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les marchés locaux, ainsi qu'avec la gestion régionale et d'autres fonctions du Groupe, ce rôle comprendra la planification, la prestation et l'évolution de ces outils afin de s'assurer que les connaissances fondées sur les données sont générées afin d'influencer les décisions et les actions des entreprises. À mesure que le volume, le volume et la complexité des données augmentent, nous sommes en train d'évoluer dans notre façon de travailler - en adoptant des outils d'IA pour accélérer le traitement des données et transformer la façon dont les connaissances sont présentées à l'entreprise. Notre intention est de consacrer moins de temps à la production et plus de temps à l'interprétation, à la mise en œuvre et à la communication qui stimulent l'action.

Relevant du responsable du Global Brand Tracking & NPS, les responsabilités clés des candidats seront axées sur la prestation constante de ces plates-formes d'information importantes, de sorte qu'elles évoluent en fonction des besoins opérationnels et entraînent le changement.

Ce que vous ferez

- Agissez en tant que championne de la clientèle, sensibilisez-vous, fournissant des conseils et de la formation à l'organisation sur les dimensions clés et les points de vue de notre programme pour diriger les actions.

- Prendre en charge les deux études mondiales continues et les études RNPS ad hoc de détail assurant une gestion de projet en douceur et la livraison de données solides et pertinentes et d'IPK dans l'entreprise.

- Appliquer l'intelligence artificielle et les nouvelles technologies aux travaux d'information afin d'accroître l'efficacité du traitement, de la synthèse et de l'établissement de rapports, ce qui permet de mettre l'accent sur l'interprétation, le narratif et les implications commerciales.

- Définir, développer et mener des études globales, en coordination entre une multitude de marchés et des partenariats avec l'agence concernée.

- Analyser les réactions, en tirer des conclusions, en rendre compte et les présenter aux parties prenantes de l'ensemble de l'organisation, y compris à la haute direction aux niveaux mondial, régional et local.

- Conduire la combinaison de sources de données pour renforcer la pertinence pour la prise de décision et l'impact sur le rendement, par exemple l'analyse de corrélation reliant l'expérience client aux finances.

- S'assurer que les programmes sont techniquement solides et appropriés grâce à l'élaboration de questionnaires, à l'échantillonnage, aux règles de pondération et au téléchargement de données renforçant la confiance dans l'outil.

- Traduire des idées analytiques en recommandations concrètes réalisables, en tirer des conclusions pour l'amélioration des entreprises et influencer efficacement la stratégie, y compris la facilitation des ateliers.

- Maintenir et promouvoir notre plateforme d'hébergement de données pour démocratiser les idées dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise.

- Gérer les organismes de recherche externes et les budgets.

- Soutien des intrants au gestionnaire principal de l'information pour l'identification, la communication et l'activation des idées.

- Suivre les meilleures pratiques dans le domaine et transférer les sujets pertinents dans les programmes de Zurich.

Le lieu de travail est Zurich avec des déplacements potentiellement nécessaires jusqu'à 10%

Ce que vous apportez

- Baccalauréat ou maîtrise (p. ex., en études d'affaires/administration, recherche, sciences des données, psychologie, sciences du comportement, gestion du client ou du changement), 5+ années d'expérience dans la gestion des connaissances aux programmes d'actions.

- Expertise dans la gestion de la recherche client dans le cadre d'une équipe interne de perspicacité client ou dans le cadre d'une pratique de conseil, idéalement associée à une solide expertise en NPS et/ou méthodologie de suivi de la marque.

- Une curiosité et une expérience en explorant ou en appliquant des outils d'intelligence artificielle dans un contexte de recherche/d'observation (p. ex., analyse textuelle, rapports automatisés, synthèse croisée des marchés).

- Passionné et curieux de l'analyse des données et de l'identification des idées pour faciliter la planification d'action.

- Compétences en gestion et en coordination du programme pour élaborer et diriger des études sur plus de 19 marchés, y compris la gestion de la préparation et de l'exécution des études (p. ex., mise en place et conception des études, définition de la stratégie d'échantillonnage, exécution, rapports), l'harmonisation des marchés et l'application et le respect du cadre d'étude global.

- Capacité de travailler avec de plus grands ensembles de données (Excel, SPSS) pour fournir une analyse supplémentaire/ad hoc (créer des coupes de données en fonction des différentes exigences des intervenants en plus des ensembles de résultats de l'organisme).

- Expérience dans le travail avec les marchés à travers le monde ainsi que la capacité d'établir et de gérer des relations entre différentes grappes culturelles.

- Forte capacité d'analyse, d'écriture et de communication, ainsi que de facilitation des ateliers.

- Capacité de guider les équipes virtuelles, p. ex., établir et diriger la communauté mondiale des COV.

- Connaissance approfondie du marché, des opérations, des produits et des services d'assurance.

- La langue de travail est principalement l'anglais.

Tu es ici.

Imaginez travailler dans l'un des lieux de travail les plus durables du monde. Au campus Quai Zurich , vous profiterez d'un environnement conçu pour vous aider à prospérer, avec des avantages qui soutiennent votre bien-être et votre impact, et des occasions de se produire à votre meilleur, entouré de talents et de collègues de soutien.

Vous aurez accès à des options alimentaires saines, des installations de remise en forme et des espaces de collaboration lumineux qui stimulent la créativité. Situé au cœur de Zurich sur les rives du lac de Zurich, le campus offre d'excellentes liaisons de transport en commun, ce qui facilite votre trajet.

Développez avec nous grâce à l'accès aux ressources d'apprentissage, au développement en cours d'emploi et à l'autonomisation et au soutien continus. Faites partie d'une équipe qui crée ensemble un avenir meilleur.

À propos de nous

Zurich est un assureur multiligne leader, desservant plus de 82 millions de clients dans plus de 200 pays et territoires avec plus de 65 000 employés.

Depuis plus de 150 ans, Zurich transforme l'assurance en offrant non seulement une protection, mais aussi des services de prévention qui favorisent le bien-être et la résilience climatique.

Guidée par notre objectif de « créer ensemble un avenir meilleur », nous visons à être l'une des entreprises les plus responsables et les plus influentes du monde.

Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature en ligne aujourd'hui!

jobs.description:
Global Specialty is a strategic growth business within Zurich, bringing together deep technical expertise, disciplined underwriting and global capabilities to help customers manage complex and evolving risks. With specialist teams across Marine, Energy, Financial Lines, Construction, Cyber, Credit & Surety, Accident & Health and other specialty lines, Global Specialty combines market-leading underwriting, claims and risk engineering expertise to deliver tailored solutions for clients around the world.

Our Marine Europe business plays a vital role in supporting international trade and commerce by providing specialist insurance solutions across a broad range of marine risks. Working closely with customers, brokers and colleagues across the region, the team offers deep technical expertise in marine underwriting and portfolio management, helping clients navigate an increasingly complex risk landscape while driving profitable and sustainable growth.

We are seeking a highly experienced and motivated individual to join Zurich’s Global Specialty Underwriting team as Head of Marine – Europe. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading the underwriting strategy and performance of Zurich's Marine portfolio across Europe, driving profitable growth, portfolio optimisation and underwriting excellence whilst ensuring consistent execution across the region.

What you will do

• Set and oversee execution of the Marine underwriting strategy across Europe, ensuring alignment with business objectives and delivery of target portfolio performance.

• Take accountability for portfolio performance through the use of data, analytics, performance metrics and market insights, identifying opportunities and risks and implementing changes where required.

• Monitor and analyse market trends, customer needs, distribution dynamics and regulatory developments relevant to the marine sector and adjust strategy accordingly.

• Hold ultimate accountability for financial results across the European Marine portfolio.

• Collaborate closely with Claims, Risk Engineering, Distribution and other internal stakeholders to achieve business objectives and deliver strong customer outcomes.

• Develop and maintain relationships with key clients, brokers and market partners to support profitable portfolio growth, and engage with reinsurers, regulators and rating agencies as required.

• Participate in regulatory, compliance and governance-related activities relevant to the line of business.

• Ensure the development of appropriate underwriting capabilities across Marine and foster a proactive, inclusive approach to talent development, succession planning and recruitment.

• Act as a subject matter expert, supporting the development and delivery of line of business underwriting training across the region.

• Drive continuous improvement of underwriting tools, processes and operational efficiency across the Marine line of business.

• Act as a referral point for underwriting decisions requiring higher levels of empowerment and support underwriters on the largest and most complex individual deals.

• Lead and contribute to underwriting reviews, identifying performance trends and ensuring agreed actions are implemented.

What you will bring

• Demonstrated expertise in underwriting marine risks and managing marine underwriting portfolios, with a proven track record of delivering profitable growth.

• Deep understanding of the European marine market, underwriting landscape and regulatory environment.

• Strong portfolio management capabilities with experience leveraging data-driven insights to inform strategic decisions.

• Proven ability to develop and implement underwriting strategies across multiple markets.

• Excellent leadership skills, with the ability to lead, motivate and foster a culture of trust, accountability and high performance across geographically dispersed teams.

• Strong technical underwriting expertise and credibility within the market.

• Exceptional influencing, negotiation and stakeholder management skills, including experience engaging with senior executives, brokers and external partners.

• Highly effective communicator with the ability to build strong internal and external relationships.

• Strong commercial acumen and customer-centric mindset.

• Excellent English language skills.

You belong here.

Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus , you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.
You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple.
Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together.

About Us

Zurich is a leading multi-line insurer, serving over 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories with more than 65,000 employees.
For over 150 years, Zurich has been transforming insurance – offering not just protection, but also prevention services that promote well-being and climate resilience.
Guided by our purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ we aim to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world.
We look forward to receiving your online application today!

Information for recruitment agencies

Zurich does not accept any applications from recruitment agencies for this position. We refuse any responsibility for unsolicited applications, as well as any associated fees.

Why Zurich

At Zurich, we like to think outsid

Con team specializzati in Marine, Energy, Financial Lines, Construction, Cyber, Credit & Surety, Accident & Health e altre linee speciali, Global Specialty combina competenze di sottoscrizione leader di mercato, reclami e ingegneria del rischio per fornire soluzioni su misura per i clienti di tutto il mondo.

Il nostro business Marine Europe svolge un ruolo vitale nel sostenere il commercio internazionale e il commercio fornendo soluzioni di assicurazione specialistiche in una vasta gamma di rischi marini.
